utv.uk.description: In Donegal Town, Dermot's journey takes him further south along the Wild Atlantic Way, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its beautifully flecked fabric. Dressed fit for a fine meal, Dermot visits one of Ireland's most unexpected culinary hotspots: Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house. He meets Bangladeshi-born chef Rana, and together they cook railway curry using outstanding local Donegal lamb and potatoes - it's a heaven-made match of Asian flavours and quality Irish produce. For pudding, Dermot meets chef Brian McDermott, one of the biggest champions of Donegal's food scene. Together they bake a classic Irish apple pie, with Brian revealing why all the local rain creates richer grass, creamier milk and extra buttery pastry, making Donegal Town a dessert destination. - 2024

utv.uk.description: The 18th entry in the James Bond film series. Media tycoon Elliot Carver is one of the most powerful men in the world - his newspaper Tomorrow is a world leader in that industry, and he is about to launch a satellite network to capitalise on his success. However, he is hungry for more business - especially from the Asian market - and when a British Royal Navy ship is mysteriously sunk in the South China Sea by unknown means and any survivors of the attack are killed afterwards, Tomorrow manages to be first to tell the world that the survivors' bodies were riddled with Chinese bullets. China repeatedly denies any responsibility for the attack, but Admiral Roebuck of the Royal Navy insists that China are to blame. However, M - the venerable boss of MI6 - suspects that there is more to the attack and therefore sends James Bond on a mission to find the real cause behind the sinking of the British ship. bbconemidlands.uk.title: Shrek Forever After
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Animated fantasy comedy, the fourth adventure about the grumpy, green ogre, featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Cameron Diaz and Eddie Murphy. Bored with his new-found domesticity, Shrek makes a deal with Rumpelstiltskin that will allow him to return to something like his old life. Things don't go to plan, however, when Shrek finds himself in a land where ogres are hunted and he and Princess Fiona have never met.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Kingdom
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E5 Olin's Last Chance The lion pride have grown stronger than ever, and the wild dogs have dwindled. Leopard Mutima returns home, while her ageing mother Olimba must overcome injury if she is to succeed in one final challenge. A new hyena queen rises from chaos, but can she regain ground from the lions? Even the powerful lion pride are under threat, especially when crossing Nsefu's crocodile-ridden waters.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Countryfile
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2026 Yr Wyddfa Charlotte Smith and Joe Crowley visit Yr Wyddfa, Wales' highest mountain, to meet the people caring for its landscape and keeping more than 600,000 visitors a year on the move. Joe joins volunteers tackling litter and discovers efforts to protect rare alpine plants and the elusive Snowdon beetle, while Charlotte goes behind the scenes at Wales' highest cafe. Plus, Tom Heap investigates how organised crime gangs are targeting the countryside.

itv1anglia.uk.description: S11 E207 16/10/2026 A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

itv1anglia.uk.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
itv1anglia.uk.description: S37 E5 Tom Allen presents a compilation of clangers, featuring Ryan Gosling, Stephen Fry, Damian Lewis, Alison Hammond, Alan Titchmarsh, Amanda Holden and more. Unscripted moments include an alpaca using the This Morning studio floor as a toilet.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Emmerdale
itv1anglia.uk.description: E10679 16/10/2026 Sadie reels Ruby back in with a sob story, while Robert plans to win big and Moria is feeling alienated.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Coronation Street
itv1anglia.uk.description: E11964 16/10/2026 Gary and Kit take their turns in the witness box, Nick resents Idris muscling in on his son and his livelihood and Ken suggests a new focus for Daniel. Debbie scuppers her own treat for Ronnie's birthday.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Beat the Chasers
itv1anglia.uk.description: S6 E3 Bradley Walsh hosts as five contestants from across the country - Ellie May, Yinka, Carl, Helen and Charles - look to win big money. However, they will have to take down six of the best - The Sinnerman, The Beast, The Governess, The Menace, The Vixen and The Dark Destroyer - to do so.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: S11 E207 16/10/2026 A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News Anglia; Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: Breaking news and current stories from across the East of England.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
itv1anglia.uk.description: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E2 A look at the investigation into the murders of Carol and Stephen Baxter, a wealthy couple in their 60s who were found dead by their daughter on Easter Sunday in 2023 in Essex.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Deal or No Deal
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E65 Matt Join Stephen Mulhern as Matt gets his opportunity to open the iconic red boxes - in the game show with only one question, will Matt say 'Deal' or 'No deal' when faced with the Banker's tempting offers or choose to take home what's inside his randomly selected box instead.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Casino Royale
itv1anglia.uk.description: James Bond spoof, starring David Niven, Peter Sellers and Ursula Andress. Agent 007, whose exploits on behalf of his country have resulted in a knighthood, is now enjoying his retirement to the full. But when "M" is killed, Bond is called back into active service to halt the threat of the cash-strapped SMERSH organisation.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E13 Lafayette The chef heads towards Louisiana's swamplands, where he ditches his car for a high-speed boat. He travels to the nearby city of Lafayette, where he visits the family run smokehouse Johnson's Boucaniere, and samples some of their traditional home-made sausage. James also tries ice cream from the famous Borden's ice cream parlour, before heading back to the swamps to cook one final dish.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News
itv1anglia.uk.description: E79 17/10/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E31 James cooks two vegan dishes for comedian and TV presenter Sara Pascoe, while the guest chefs are Francesco Mazzei, Richard Bertinet and Alistair Barsby.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E2 The Big Gathering Irish chef and author Clodagh McKenna hosts a big gathering for friends and family in her garden featuring a super-easy menu. Among the dishes she makes for the event are a speedy garden herb dip, a crowd-pleasing chocolate beef chilli and a showstopping tarte Tatin using shop-bought puff pastry.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: E76 17/10/2026 - 1 Round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV Racing: Live from Ascot : 17/10/2026
itv1anglia.uk.description: Francesca Cumani and Ed Chamberlin present live coverage of all seven races on Champions Day, including feature race the Queen Elizabeth II Stakes. With analysis from Jason Weaver, Ruby Walsh and Adele Mulrennan, reports by Matt Chapman, Luke Harvey and Oli Bell, and commentary from Richard Hoiles.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Tipping Point: Lucky Stars
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E1 Ben Shephard hosts as Christopher Biggins, Rosemary Shrager and Gareth Chilcott answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the better their chances of collecting the £20,000 prize for their selected charity.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Chase
itv1anglia.uk.description: S17 E29 Bradley Walsh presents as contestants Sarah from Cirencester, James from Dartford, Sandy from Culross and Helena from Liverpool pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Win Win
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E4 Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host the interactive quiz show in which viewers get the chance to win the same prizes as the contestants playing in the studio. Plus, a viewer from last week's show joins Mel and Sue in the studio where contestants face a nail-biting decision: do they take a prize and leave the game, or do they join Millionaire's Row.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Voice UK
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2026 E8 Emma Willis hosts as the battle rounds begin, with coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones putting their teams through more challenges Joined by special guest mentors, the coaches prepare their artists for a series of head-to-head performances before making the difficult decision of which three singers from each team will progress to the semi-final.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E1 Alison Hammond and her son Aidan, Carol Vorderman and her son Cameron, and Iain Stirling and his mum Alison compete in the comedy game show. Aidan comes close to damaging the family brand, Carol makes life difficult for Cameron and Romesh's mum Shanthi has her head turned by the sight of Iain in long johns.

itv1anglia.uk.title: English Football League Highlights : 17/10/2026
itv1anglia.uk.description: S5 E13 Action from the latest matches, including Swansea City v West Ham United at Swansea.com Stadium, Middlesbrough v Cardiff City at Riverside Stadium, and Southampton v Bolton Wanderers at St Mary's Stadium in the Championship.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E8 Donegal Town Dermot reaches Donegal Town, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its flecked fabric. He visits Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house, where he and Bangladeshi-born chef Rana cook railway curry using outstanding local lamb and potatoes. For pudding, Dermot bakes a classic Irish apple pie with chef Brian McDermott, who explain how the rain improves local produce.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itv1anglia.uk.description: S8 E26 Alan is joined by Mark Benton, Elizabeth Carling and Bill Fellows, while florist Simon Lycett creates a new centrepiece for the barn using seasonal blooms.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itv1anglia.uk.description: S5 E3 Liz and Kelvin discover that some farming questions are a lot harder to answer than others when Milo gets inquisitive about artificially inseminating the pigs. The farmhouse clear-out begins in earnest as plans are in for the renovation works, while with the Royal Cheshire Country Show looming, Marnie takes on the challenge of halter-training orphan lamb Hope.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
itv1anglia.uk.description: S6 E2 Budget Week Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as Bez of Happy Mondays and TV presenters Scarlett Moffatt and Zara McDermott go head-to-head in a three-way cooking battle. With the help of their mentors, they have to produce gourmet dishes with a budget of just £3 a portion, with two of the stars facing the cook-off, after which one will leave the competition.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Talking Royals
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E2 A weekly round-up of royal news, with expert analysis from ITV News' royal editor Chris Ship and expert Lizzie Robinson, and guests.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: E77 18/10/2026 - 1 Round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Tomorrow Never Dies
itv1anglia.uk.description: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Jonathan Pryce and Michelle Yeoh. Intending to reap the profits of increased ratings for his global multimedia empire, Elliot Carver attempts to ignite a conflict between Britain and China by sinking a British frigate and shooting down a Chinese fighter plane. The British Secret Service sends James Bond to verify suspicions that Carver is behind the incident.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Celebrity Lingo
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E7 Adil Ray hosts the game of words as journalist Cathy Newman and wordsmith Gyles Brandreth compete against Loose Women's Kaye Adams and Morning Live's Ranj Singh for charity.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Tipping Point: Lucky Stars
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E5 Ben Shephard asks the questions as Phil Tufnell, Colin Jackson and Lisa Riley answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the better their chances of collecting the £20,000 prize for their selected charity.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Chase
itv1anglia.uk.description: S17 E36 Bradley Walsh presents as Jayne from Glossop, Eileen from Carrickfergus, Matthew from West Yorkshire and Keith from St Albans work as a team to take on one of the ruthless Chasers and secure a cash prize.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch

babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam find a hungry mouse while enjoying thier picnic. They give it some bread and cheese and then they all play hide and seek!

babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam learn how to mix colors in order to make new ones. When they finish painting, they use the colorful bottles as bowling pins.

babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun playing an imaginative game with paper towels and inventing their own song about a choo-choo train!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become artists! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a paintbrush and easel! S1 Ep19

babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a song bird! See what happens when poisonous rattle snakes arrive! Everyone is in a different rhythm!

babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets Mrs. Salmon by the river! Salmon jumped too far and landed outside the water!

babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail discovers a nest on a porch! Join him as he sees a little chick hatch from its egg!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail explores grass in a garden! Join him as he meets a grasshopper! Discover how his green colour helps him hide from lizards!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: It's Autumn! It's getting chilly and the leaves start to fall! Join Mr. Snail as he meets Robin Red Breast.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit a magical castle in the winter time! They play hide and seek with a friendly dragon.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu have fun in their imaginary circus world.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu have fun in their imaginary and colorful circus world.

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Harley and Perry play football together. Perry turns out to be quite a talented player. When it's Harley's turn, she's not as successful.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Pix and Leo are envious of the chicks getting a flying lesson from mama bird. They also want to fly. But flying without wings is not so easy...

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Ikki asks Mowgli to look after little Sahi while he's napping. Mowgli thinks it will be a breeze but boy is he wrong!

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: When mama bird goes to find food for her chicks, the mischievous chicks leave the nest.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: Everyone ready? It's time to learn how to fly! Mama bird teaches her three chicks how to fly.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: It's Coco's birthday and the gang have planned a surprise party for him! They even invited the Coral Reef singers!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Canada. The friends want to eat pancakes but have no peanut butter!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Denmark. The King asks his daughters to bring him the most beautiful crown in the world!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Dayo is looking for a blue seashell. Numsa tells him she dreamt she found one under a tamarisk tree! Dig with Dayo and find the unique seashell!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become car mechanics! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a toolbox and tires!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become gardeners! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a rake and a trowel! Enter the garden.

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become tennis players! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a tennis racket and wrist bands!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun using pan lids as cymbals, singing, and dancing in their band.

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam Bam have fun picking oranges from the tree and catching them in a bowl.

babytv.uk.title: Bug'n'Play to the Rescue

babytv.uk.description: Olly's adventure is out of this world! He's flying to the moon and Kitty, Dolly and Snail join in on the fun!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle

babytv.uk.description: If you have a mouse near your house why don't you try dancing with it? Wiggle your tail and start sniffing!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Wag your tail and put up your paws - come dance like a cat. Don't forget "Meow"!

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie and Number Three in their search for three wheels of Number Three's ice cream delivery wagon.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Number Four helps Charlie fix his bike by turning four thorns on its wheel into four flowers.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes

babytv.uk.description: Blue triangle and Orange triangle's ball gets stuck in a tree. How will they get it down?

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Can you stand on your head? Come see the shapes compete who can stand on their head the longest.

amc.us.description: Hockey-masked slasher Jason (Kane Hodder) follows a Crystal Lake teen (Jensen Daggett) and her friends on a cruise to New York. - 1989

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
amc.us.description: Teenage Tommy (Thom Mathews) meets masked-killer Jason, brought back by a lightning bolt at the lake. - 1986

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th: Part 7: The New Blood
amc.us.description: A psychic teen's (Lar Park Lincoln) psychiatrist (Terry Kiser) sends her and her mother (Susan Blu) to Crystal Lake, home of hockey-masked Jason. - 1988

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th
amc.us.description: The reopening of Camp Crystal Lake spells murder and mayhem for a group of sexually promiscuous counselors. - 1980

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
amc.us.description: Mrs. Voorhees' son Jason is waiting when another load of teens (Amy Steel, John Furey, Adrienne King) tries to make a buck at Camp Crystal. - 1981

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
amc.us.description: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together -- that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

amc.us.title: Stephen King's It
amc.us.description: Seven friends engage in a struggle with the demon they first encountered 30-years earlier in their Maine hometown. From the Stephen King book. (Horror, Drama, Mystery, Thriller, Miniseries) - 1990-11-18

amc.us.title: Stephen King's It
amc.us.description: Seven friends engage in a struggle with the demon they first encountered 30-years earlier in their Maine hometown. From the Stephen King book. (Horror, Drama, Mystery, Thriller, Miniseries) - 1990-11-20

amc.us.title: The Omen
amc.us.description: American diplomat Robert (Gregory Peck) adopts Damien (Harvey Stephens) when his wife, Katherine (Lee Remick), delivers a stillborn child. After Damien's first nanny hangs herself, Father Brennan (Patrick Troughton) warns Robert that Damien will kill Katherine's unborn child. Shortly thereafter, Brennan dies and Katherine miscarries when Damien pushes her off a balcony. As more people around Damien die, Robert investigates Damien's background and realizes his adopted son may be the Antichrist. (Horror, Thriller) - 1976

amc.us.title: The Amityville Horror
amc.us.description: Chiller about a family who is terrorized by supernatural forces when they move into a new house in New York State which was the scene of a recent mass killing and the home of an 18th-century satanist. When swarms of flies appear from nowhere and the pipes and walls begin to ooze slime and blood, they call on a local priest to exorcize the evil spirits. (Horror) - 1979

amc.us.title: The Amityville Horror
amc.us.description: When George Lutz (Ryan Reynolds) and his wife, Kathy (Melissa George), find a beautiful new house in the small town of Amityville, N.Y., they think the place is too good to be true. After they move in with their kids, they find out the cheap price tag is thanks to the house's sordid history: The former tenant murdered his family after supposedly being possessed by the devil. Believing the home is haunted, the couple find a priest (Philip Baker Hall) to help them rid the place of evil spirits. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: The Omen
amc.us.description: A new age of evil threatens to arise when an American diplomat (Liev Schreiber) and his wife (Julia Stiles) learn that the child (Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick) they adopted may be the son of Satan. Mystical signs point to the Antichrist's coming battle for dominion over heaven and Earth. (Horror) - 2006

amc.us.title: Insidious
amc.us.description: A family looks to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

amc.us.title: The Conjuring
amc.us.description: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

amc.us.title: Final Destination
amc.us.description: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

amc.us.title: Final Destination 2
amc.us.description: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

amc.us.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
amc.us.description: A year after running over a fisherman and dumping his body in the water, four friends reconvene when Julie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) receives a frightening letter telling her that their crime was seen. While pursuing who he thinks is responsible for the letter, Barry (Ryan Phillippe) is run over by a man with a meat hook. The bloodletting only increases from there, as the killer with the hook continues to stalk Julie, Helen (Sarah Michelle Gellar) and Ray (Freddie Prinze Jr.). (Horror, Thriller) - 1997

amc.us.title: The Final Destination
amc.us.description: While enjoying a day at the track, Nick O'Bannon (Bobby Campo) has a horrific premonition of his friends and him all dying in a freak accident involving many racecars. Mere seconds before the vision comes true, he manages to convince them to leave. Although they cheat death then, the survivors each begin to meet a grisly end, and Nick tries to figure a way to escape a similar fate. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: The Mist
amc.us.description: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice. (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2007

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
amc.us.description: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together -- that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th
amc.us.description: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent. (Horror) - 1980

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
amc.us.description: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people. (Horror, Action, Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1981

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
amc.us.description: During a hallucinatory incident, young Kristen Parker (Patricia Arquette) has her wrists slashed by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). Her mother, mistaking the wounds for a suicide attempt, sends Kristen to a psychiatric ward, where she joins a group of similarly troubled teens. One of the doctors there is Nancy Thompson (Heather Langenkamp), who had battled Freddy some years before. Nancy senses a potential in Kristen to rid the world of Freddy once and for all. (Horror) - 1987

(Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Breakfast, Brisket and Belly
foodnetwork.us.description: In Los Angeles, a late-night spot serves breakfast with a twist, like drunken French toast; in Columbus, Ohio, a funky joint serves creative combos like brisket on corn cakes; in Phoenix, a barbecue stop smokes up prime rib and pork belly dumplings.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Seafood and Savory
foodnetwork.us.description: A Lansing, Mich., food truck dishes out shrimp burgers and a unique potato popper; a Bosnian restaurant in Tucson, Ariz., fires up legit Eastern European specialties; a down-home Southern seafood spot cooks up clam chowder and fries up favorites.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Tasty Traditions
foodnetwork.us.description: In Seattle, a funky spot makes their name with scratch-made Russian piroshki; a joint in Kona serves up a bite of culture with their authentic Hawaiian cuisine; in Chicago, an old-school Jewish deli dishes out their specialties cafeteria-style.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sandwich Showcase
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri is on the road to grab some serious sandwiches; in Austin, a rock-n-roll brunch bar adds a funky touch to meatloaf and a Monte Cristo; a Texas joint puts some '90s hip-hop into its stacked-up specialties.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Coming Together in Cali
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy visits Chico, Calif., celebrating the town's food scene as residents recover from ravaging fires; a wood-fired Italian spot cooks up pork ragù; a bakery serves up savory specialties like black bean chili; a pub serves a "Pho-rench Dip."

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Eating Alaska
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri and his son, Hunter, are taking a culinary journey up to Juneau, Alaska, and they dive into everything from a family-run, wood-fired pizza wagon making reindeer pie to a funky basement spot mashing up Latin-Asian fusion.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Family Meals
foodnetwork.us.description: Two brothers-in-law carry on a decades-long seafood tradition; a mother-son duo running a breakfast, lunch and dinner joint in honor of their Pop; father-son meat masters firing up killer char-becue.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Lots of Latin
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri is loading up on all kinds of Latin on this trip; in Logan, Utah, a Salvadoran spot puttin' out pupusas and a cabeza creation.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Authentic to Inventive
foodnetwork.us.description: Dishes from real deal to really creative; in Portland, Ore., a 70-year-old icon is serving up authentic Chinese recipes from the chef's hometown; a restaurant in Oklahoma City is cooking chicken and biscuits.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Meat and Heat
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri rolls into a tucked-away panini paradise in Chehalis, Wash.; a Korean spot in Brentwood, Tenn., gets spicy with its chicken and bulgogi; in Houston, a barbecue joint throws Tex-Mex into the mix with brisket tacos and jalapeño sausage.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Appetizers to Dessert
foodnetwork.us.description: In Laramie, Wyo., an old-school café has green chili burritos and pie; a spot in Anchorage, Alaska has blackened chicken gnocchi.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Thai, Pie and Fries
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's diving into Thai food, pie and hearty fries; in San Diego, a spot is serving fish and ribs; in Arroyo Seco, N.M., a New Zealand food truck makes meat pies; a cozy joint loads up bison chili fries.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Mexican, Mediterranean and Mofongo
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's grabbing an international playlist of flavor; in Florida, a funky spot is putting a Mediterranean spin on burgers, while a local gem is dishing out Puerto Rican specialties; in Las Vegas, a real deal Mexican joint has bomb birria tacos.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Champion Chefs
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's visiting restaurants owned by familiar Food Network faces; in Studio City, Calif., chef Antonia Lofaso is cooking up global flavors, and in Rapid City, S.D., chef Justin Warner is serving up righteous ramen and dynamite dumplings.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sandwiches, Sausage & Sweets
foodnetwork.us.description: Savoring sammies, sausage, and sweets; a funky Filipino joint in Sacramento, Calif., is making cookies; a West Palm Beach, Fla., spot is smoking gator sausage; an elevated eatery in Tampa, Fla., is plating an out-of-bounds Italian sandwich.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Buns, Burgers and Bolognese
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's digging into pork dumplings from a husband-and-wife team in Sacramento, Calif.; a Palm Beach Gardens, Fla. Bistro is mixing up a meat sauce; a mom-and-pop shop in San Jose, Calif. Serves up black bean burgers.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Triple D Nation: Beef It Up ᴺᵉʷ
foodnetwork.us.description: Fieri's headed back to some top spots, starting with an Austin, TX, institution scratch-making garden enchiladas; in Reno, NV, a BBQ joint is putting out mouthwatering meatloaf, and a New Orleans landmark is plating killer catfish with crawfish mac.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Beef, Bowls, and Burritos
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's getting into next-level bowls, burritos and more!; there's karaage chicken in Rogers, AR, and a Seattle spot is putting a Lebanese spin on tacos and burritos; plus, a joint in Bentonville, AR, is serving a serious smoked French dip.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
foodnetwork.us.description: With roadside diners, vintage drive-ins and out-of-the-way "dives" enjoying a resurgence of hipness among foodies, host Guy Fieri travels across America in search of some of the best "greasy spoon" eateries. The restaurants that Guy visits are usually well-known among locals and other people in the region. While at each location, Fieri talks to the staff as well as the customers to get their thoughts on the food. Many episodes feature eateries that are connected by a common thread, such as burgers or comfort foods. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2007-04-23

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Top-Speed Trans Am!
motortrend.us.description: The guys attempt to build their '99 Trans Am into a 200-mph club member to compete at the Arkansas Mile; Keith Turk helps the guys find out how much horsepower they need to make, and they begin one of their most complex builds yet.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Pigpen vs. Crown Hick: Battle of the Body Swaps!
motortrend.us.description: The guys take on Hot Rod Garage's Lucky Costa and improve their shop truck Pigpen; it's their LS7-powered 1950 GMC 100 on an S15 chassis versus Lucky's 1966 Ford F-100 with a supercharged 4.6L on a police car chassis known as the Crown Hick.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Shocking Gains and Boosting the '60 Biscayne!
motortrend.us.description: The guys take a 1960 Chevrolet Biscayne and completely overhaul the suspension with an unconventional setup and supercharge the engine to make up time against a '66 Mustang GT350.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Hemi-Powered Monte Carlo!
motortrend.us.description: Newbern and Cotten take a G-Body to new heights when they swap a third-gen Hemi into a 1984 Monte Carlo.

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - 200mph Trans AM!
motortrend.us.description: What does it take to get a Trans Am to 200 mph? The guys swing for the fences in an attempt at the elusive top speed of 200 mph.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Bootleg Ford Fixing and Road Trip!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich death-proof their questionably assembled '40 Ford Fordor, then hit the road to multiple junkyards to hunt for a new project vehicle; after a lengthy search, they fall in love with a barn-find '60s truck that's too good.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Muscle Truck 4-Link Fabrication!
motortrend.us.description: The '73 Chevy step-side muscle truck has a storied history; Freiburger and guest host Dave Chappelle fabricate another chapter in the truck's saga with the addition of a beefy four-link suspension and coilovers to hopefully get it to sit right.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - 1000+ hp Pro Street Nova!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich add 1,000+ hp to David's Pro Street 1969 Chevy Nova; in an attempt to make a true street/strip car, the guys fully build out this roller before taking it to the track to run some impressive times out of the gate.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Crusher Camaro on Power Tour West!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich return the '67 Crusher Camaro to its original styling, then hit the road to Vegas and back for Hot Rod's first-ever Power Tour West.

The pirates kidnap the governor's daughter, Elizabeth (Keira Knightley), who's in possession of a valuable coin that is linked to a curse that has transformed the pirates into the undead. Jack's only hope of survival lies in seeking out the legendary Trident of Poseidon, but to find it, he must forge an uneasy alliance with a brilliant and beautiful astronomer and a headstrong young man in the British navy. spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.title: Birth of a Dynasty : Chapter 1
spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.description: The 1999-2000 off-season was a sea change for the Lakers, defined by the arrival of Phil Jackson and the move from the beloved Forum into brand-new STAPLES Center. It also started with a setback of a Kobe Bryant hand injury.

spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.title: Birth of a Dynasty : Chapter 2
spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal's renewed focus and dedication takes his game to new heights, resulting with his first MVP award. The team also barrels its way towards one of the best regular seasons in franchise history.

spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.title: Birth of a Dynasty : Chapter 3 - Brink of Elimination
spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.description: The playoff run includes a first-round series win over the Kings. A hard fought Western Conference Finals between the Lakers and Blazers comes down to an incredible 4th quarter in Game 7, with the Lakers down 15 and on the brink of elimination.

spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.title: Birth of a Dynasty : Chapter 4- The Comeback to Champions
spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.description: After completing one of the greatest fourth quarter comebacks in NBA history, the Lakers prevail in the NBA Finals over the Indiana Pacers in six games, with a monumental celebration outside STAPLES Center.

sundancetv.us.title: Christine
sundancetv.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

sundancetv.us.title: The Shining
sundancetv.us.description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family. (Comedy) - 1966

sundancetv.us.description: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity. (Horror, Thriller) - 1984

sundancetv.us.title: Pet Sematary
sundancetv.us.description: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. (Horror, Thriller) - 1989

sundancetv.us.title: Cujo
sundancetv.us.description: In this tale of a killer canine, man's best friend turns into his worst enemy. When sweet St. Bernard Cujo is bitten by a bat, he starts behaving oddly and becomes very aggressive. As Cujo morphs into a dangerous beast, he goes on a rampage in a small town. Stay-at-home mom Donna (Dee Wallace) gets caught in Cujo's crosshairs on a fateful errand with her son, Tad (Danny Pintauro). Stuck in their tiny car, Donna and Tad have a frightening showdown with the crazed animal. (Horror, Thriller) - 1983

sundancetv.us.title: Silver Bullet

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Swindon, busy working couple Nicola and Anthony moved to their new house a year ago. They regard it as their forever dream home, the garden is letting them down and they hope to bring some Mediterranean glamour to it.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Jeannie and Norman have spent their retirement making the most of their long garden in Petersfield, Hampshire, but they want to turn an area at the back into a secluded, calm, Japanese-inspired 'garden within a garden' just for them.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team are in Daresbury in Chester with downsizers, Karen and Alan. The couple have a small, wedge-shaped garden with so little in it that the only thing to look at is the fences, but those fences don't even provide privacy from the neighbours.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team visit Bernadette, a dedicated social worker for troubled adults who has always put the needs of others before her own. Having recently turned sixty, Bernadette finally wants some 'me time': a new garden could give her a well-deserved reward.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: In the last programme of the current series, Monty Don takes stock of his year at Longmeadow. We visit RHS Wisley to learn why autumn leaves are such a precious commodity for our gardens, and in the final instalment of her botany series, Carol Klein celebrates the glorious displays put on by flowering plants to attract pollinators.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As usual, Monty is at Longmeadow where he will set out his plans for the coming year. Monty reviews the effects the winter weather has had on his garden.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the gardening year gets underway at Longmeadow, Monty is tidying up his ornamental grass border, pruning roses and planning for summer scent. Joe Swift continues his series on trees when he gives tips for how to plant a tree for future success.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As part of his planning for summer Monty begins to sow annual climbers and gets started on tidying and mulching his borders. In the last of Joe Swift's series on trees, he learns how and when to prune them, and why. We also meet clematis enthusiast, Mike Brown, whose collection fills his garden with colour all summer long, and amongst the brutalist architecture of London's Barbican, Nick Bailey, head gardener of the Chelsea Physic Garden, discovers a hidden tropical oasis.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: The first big gardening weekend of the year gets underway with Monty dividing perennials and giving plenty of tips for how we can kick-start the garden for the season ahead. As millions of bedding plants are poised for planting in our pots and borders, Joe Swift visits a major grower to find out how they are produced and what drives the demand.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty gets to work in his wildlife garden to ensure that there are plenty of plants in flower for early pollinators. Carol Klein meets Stuart Donachie who has embraced every planting opportunity in his shady garden in Herefordshire, and Frances Tophill invites viewers to grow easy summer vegetables along with her as she trials varieties for taste and productivity at RHS Rosemoor.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty starts a new project, a cutting garden, and gives advice on what to grow to provide plenty of cut flowers for gorgeous summer bouquets. We visit Cumbria to meet Jack Gott, who has been passionate about that most flamboyant of flowers, the dahlia, for more than forty years and has over a thousand plants in his garden; and James Alexander-Sinclair celebrates a harbinger of Spring, the ephemeral cherry blossom, at Alnwick Castle in Northumberland.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty gets his new vegetable garden underway by making raised beds. He also offers advice on how to cut back herbs. Nick Bailey marks the 400th anniversary of the death of William Shakespeare when he investigates the fact and the fiction behind the Bard's potions and poisons, at the Chelsea Physic Garden; and we visit Pashley Manor in East Sussex to unearth the story behind the planting of over 25,000 tulips.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the growing season picks up a pace, Monty is sowing vegetables and planting out the scented plants, which he brought back from the Malvern Spring Festival. Carol is delving into the hedgerows and rooting at the bases of walls, fences and trees as she begins her journey to investigate why plants thrive in challenging conditions. We also return to Sissinghurst to find out about the changes Troy Scott-Smith is making to the world famous white garden.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team have an unusual challenge: to turn a long, pointed front garden into a water-saving, wildlife-friendly space. Mum Laura wants a place to encourage the bugs and creepy-crawlies that young son William loves.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Salford, the team meet Nicole, who grew up in Germany. She wants to recreate her family's German 'kleine' garden, a traditional community space divided into fruit, veg and lawn.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Charlie Dimmock and the Rich brothers Harry and David, are in Hook, Hampshire to save young couple Cat and Joel from the garden from hell. These loved-up, newly weds dream of a family garden for the children that they plan to have, a space full of grass and wildlife friendly flowers, but the trouble is, all they have now is a concrete garden made up of nothing but paving stones!.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team tackle a vertiginous three-tiered garden. This is no simple back lawn: the garden is so steep that it rises above the roof of the house to offer fantastic views of the local forest and mountain, which the owners want to take advantage of.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The Rich brothers and Arit Anderson are on a mission to create a family garden in Horsham in Sussex for James, Charlotte and their young daughter Esmé. The trouble is, at the moment, their garden is about as exciting as a blank sheet of A4 paper.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty's in the jewel garden showing which plants need protection from the elements now and which ones can be left until after the first frosts. He also plants out berried shrubs to help feed wildlife in the winter, harvests pumpkins and shows how to make use of fallen autumnal leaves.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty gives more advice on tomato-growing, Nick Bailey travels to South Africa in search of the cousins of the Crocosmia, and Advolly Richmond looks at the Victorian trend of garden theme parks.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels from the north west coast of Scotland to the north east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across the south west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow Monty's focus is on summer when he plants up containers for colour in the Jewel Garden. He also turns his attention to overcrowded ornamental grasses which, now they are beginning to put on growth, need to be split and replanted. Continuing her search for finding the right plant for the right place, Carol takes a close look at why plants survive in the cracks and crevices of walls and gives her recommendations for garden plants that will thrive in similar conditions.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: This week we are celebrating the work of the army of volunteers, which keeps gardens up and down the country looking their best for visitors. Frances Tophill continues her vegetable trials at RHS Rosemoor in Devon, when she plants out her allotment with the help of RHS volunteers and we visit the Bodnant Garden in North Wales to find out how the volunteers there guide visitors through the world famous Laburnum Arch.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: An Arkansas State Trooper is shot and killed after pulling over a van for a traffic violation. Officers apprehend the shooter, after a car chase and shootout. ATF is alerted when officers find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle. Further testing of the weapons reveals one was used in a murder several months earlier. ATF traces some of the firearms to purchases made by another man from and arms dealer. They also match silencer marks from the weapons to a third man previously arrested for stealing a flatbed truck.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Washington DC professor is shot and killed as she tries to get into her car. The killer leaves the body in the parking lot and drives away in her vehicle. A week later, a man robs a bank, and security cameras capture the same vehicle as the getaway car. The FBI believes they are dealing with the same man. Days later, the same vehicle is involved in a shootout with police, but eventually would elude them. Eventually, the vehicle is found, the interior covered with red dye from the stolen bank packs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Four inmates from a Delaware Correctional Center turn up missing in the middle of the night. A few hours later, a stolen vehicle is recovered; inside, one of the inmate's fingerprints is found, as well as the address book of one of the other fugitives. A multi-state manhunt ensues with the help of the FBI. A nearby robbery report is the agent's first tip, followed by a murder in the same neighborhood.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the Spring of 1997, a killer preying on senior citizens terrorizes the River Parish area of Southern Louisiana. By May, local police and the New Orleans FBI are exploring a connection between the April 9 murder of a 71-year old widow and the May 9 murder of a retired couple. A month later, authorities forward information on the crimes to the FBI's Behavioral Science Unit in Quantico, VA, hoping a profile will help them narrow the field of possible suspects.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On December 21, 1998, two gunmen kidnap three janitors on their way to clean the Bank of America ATM repository in Las Vegas. The gunmen force the janitors to let them in the ATM repository and hold them hostage until the armored car guards arrive to make their nightly collection. 400000091.title: The FBI Files

Upon inspection, the vault has been blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables is gone. When agents find no clues as to the robbers or their whereabouts in California, they send details of the crime to other FBI field offices. It is not long before agents in Ohio are investigating a bank vault robbery that is strikingly similar to the California heist.

400000091.title: The FBI Files

ATF is alerted when officers find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle. Further testing of the weapons reveals one was used in a murder several months earlier. ATF traces some of the firearms to purchases made by another man from and arms dealer. They also match silencer marks from the weapons to a third man previously arrested for stealing a flatbed truck.

A few hours later, a stolen vehicle is recovered; inside, one of the inmate's fingerprints is found, as well as the address book of one of the other fugitives. A multi-state manhunt ensues with the help of the FBI. A nearby robbery report is the agent's first tip, followed by a murder in the same neighborhood.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the Spring of 1997, a killer preying on senior citizens terrorizes the River Parish area of Southern Louisiana. By May, local police and the New Orleans FBI are exploring a connection between the April 9 murder of a 71-year old widow and the May 9 murder of a retired couple. A month later, authorities forward information on the crimes to the FBI's Behavioral Science Unit in Quantico, VA, hoping a profile will help them narrow the field of possible suspects.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In January 1984, a U.S. Customs official disappears from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects driving a Pontiac Grand Prix. The following day, the Customs official was found dead. Two state troopers recovered the missing officer's service revolver after a fatal altercation with two men. Local police and the FBI continued searching for the suspect vehicle, prepared for a confrontation with desperate criminals.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1980s, the decapitation of a young African-American male led the Miami-Dade police department and the FBI along a trail of murder. Investigators quickly discovered that the victim was a dissident member of a religious sect headed by a man calling himself Yahweh ben Yahweh, or God, Son of God. Although the FBI believed Yahweh ben Yahweh and his followers were responsible for many murders, they could find no direct evidence linking them to the crimes.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When police in a small Washington State community began looking into the disappearance of a 22-year-old woman, they had no way of knowing it would evolve into a nationwide hunt for a sexual sadist. Police knew the killer's identity, but he was a master of disguise. The FBI was called on to help. Agents discovered that several unsuspecting women across the northwest had fallen prey to his charms.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1994, a rash of home invasion robberies take place in the metropolitan Detroit area. The thieves turn out to be part of a local gang dubbed the Home Invaders. Their crimes extend to insurance fraud, theft, and illegal lottery schemes. The Violent Crimes Task Force (VCTF) opens an investigation, and with the cooperation of a gang member who was apprehended at the scene of a crime, they are able to obtain the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of 16 gang members.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy. A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later. Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1997, FBI agents began investigating New York gas station mogul Gurmeet Dhinsa for gas pump rigging. They soon realized that Dhinsa was more than a crooked businessman, he enforced his mob-like operation with brutal violence, kidnapping and killing errant employees and any family members who questioned their deaths. FBI agents worked their way into Dhinsa's violent world.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 12, 1997, two men use a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, NJ home. The homeowner shoots at the intruders, hitting one in the hand before they escape. Camden Police respond and track the suspects to a nearby park. One of the men shoots at the officer before police arrest his accomplice. The man gives up the identity of the shooter. Twice, police stake out homes where they believe the shooter is hiding, but he eludes them.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When violent criminals strike, the FBI strikes back, employing every available resource, and creating new ones when necessary. From forensic science to criminal profiling, specialized intelligence to global fugitive tracking, the agents of the FBI battle the bad guys with a most powerful arsenal: the crime-fighter's toolbox. This special episode of The FBI Files celebrates the groundbreaking science, investigative technique, and gut-level instinct that has made the FBI the world's premier law enforcement agency.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the 1970's, Otpor, a violent arm of the Croatian National Resistance commits terroristic acts against non-supportive Croatians living in the U.S. With the help of an informant, the FBI is able to apprehend, arrest and convict members of the group for crimes ranging from conspiracy and extortion to murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: This is the story of the FBI's first capture of an international Lebanese terrorist. In June 1985, the terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian flight #405 shortly before take off in Beirut, Lebanon. On board were American citizens, a professor and his teen son. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force specifically charged with bringing the terrorist to justice in 1989.

But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors. All agents had to go on was a series of chilling phone calls, a mysterious voice, and the threat of more violence. FBI field offices from New York to Miami coordinated their efforts, determined to catch the vicious killers.

673498.title: They Rode West
673498.description: Dr. Allen Seward (Robert Francis) is the new doctor at a remote Army outpost. His liberal attitudes towards Native Americans become a source of tension between him and his superiors, especially Capt. Peter Blake (Philip Carey), who regards all Native Americans as dangerous and untrustworthy. Seward's insistence on treating several local Kiowa tribespeople for malaria further enrages Blake, who deems Seward a traitor when the Kiowa join forces with the Comanches and attack the fort.

673498.title: The Violent Men
673498.description: Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).

673498.title: The Black Dakotas
673498.description: A Confederate plot to turn the Sioux against the Union crumbles when a double agent makes off with a shipment of gold.

673498.title: Fury at Gunsight Pass
673498.description: One bank robber (David Brian) double-crosses another (Neville Brand), giving the undertaker and others a chance at the loot.

673498.title: The Last Rebel
673498.description: Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.

673498.title: Sierra Stranger
673498.description: Jess Collins, a poor miner, helps Sonny chase off two men he calls claim jumpers. When he arrives in the nearby town, he learns Sonny is no good and everyone in town is against him.

673498.title: Land Raiders
673498.description: An Arizona land-grabber (Telly Savalas) and his brother (George Maharis) renew their feud amid Army troops and Apaches.

673498.title: The Tall T
673498.description: The victims must outsmart their cruel captors after an outlaw, and his gang kidnap an heiress, her nervous husband, and a rancher.

673498.title: Coroner Creek
673498.description: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.

673498.title: Apache Ambush
673498.description: On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.

673498.title: The Mountain Men
673498.description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

673498.title: End of the Trail
673498.description: An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.

673498.title: Alvarez Kelly
673498.description: Alvarez Kelly (William Holden) is a Mexican cattle rancher who is doing his best to stay out of the Civil War. He has no interest in which side may win or lose -- Kelly is far more concerned about his own survival, and about making money. He soon finds himself in the middle of the conflict, however, when a confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) captures the rancher and forces Kelly to help his soldiers steal a nearby herd of cattle, which they desperately need for food.

673498.title: The Doolins of Oklahoma
673498.description: Old West outlaw Bill Doolin (Randolph Scott) marries a deacon's wife, but his gang will not leave him alone.

673498.title: Seminole Uprising
673498.description: An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.

673498.title: One Man Law
673498.description: Settlers and a sheriff catch on to a Chicago swindler's land scam.

673498.title: Riders of Black River
673498.description: A former Texas Ranger's plans to marry are complicated by his future brother-in-law's involvement with cattle rustlers.

673498.title: Men Without Law
673498.description: Returning from the war, Buck gets caught by Murdock, who takes his letter of introduction to the Del Reys. Posing as Buck, Murdock takes Del Ray's jewels and his daughter Jaunita. To rescue Juanita, Buck poses as Murdock.

673498.title: Renegades
673498.description: Hannah Brockway (Evelyn Keyes) has a perfect fiancé in Dr. Sam Martin (Willard Parker). Sam, who is respected by Hannah's family, is a noble man who cares for her and can make a good living in their frontier town. Yet Hannah craves adventure and finds it when she meets dashing Ben Dembrow (Larry Parks), the youngest of a notorious crime family. Together Ben and Hannah set off to forge a new life, but prejudice and strangling family ties soon bring trouble to these newlyweds.

673498.title: The Great Sioux Massacre
673498.description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

673500.title: It Had to Be You
673500.description: Society girl Victoria Stafford (Ginger Rogers) garners a reputation for leaving men at the altar. Getting engaged for a fourth time, Victoria believes she's found the right man -- until on a train she has a strange dream about a Native American who claims that he is her true love. Awakening, Victoria is startled to find the dream man, George (Cornel Wilde), who claims to really exist, while also being a figment of her imagination. Back at home, George guides Victoria to a startling discovery.

673500.title: You Can't Run Away From It
673500.description: A spoiled heiress teams up with an enterprising reporter to escape her domineering father's plan of keeping her from getting married.

673500.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
673500.description: A daughter visits her family to introduce them to her Black fiancé, whose kindness and loving demeanor changes the hearts of her reluctant parents.

673500.title: Funny Girl
673500.description: In this bittersweet, classic musical drama, the vibrant and beautiful young Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) starts out as a bit player on the New York City vaudeville stage, but works her way up to stardom on Broadway. Valued for her vocal and comedic talents by the renowned theater impresario Florenz Ziegfeld (Walter Pidgeon), Fanny thrives, but her relationship with her suave, imprisoned businessman husband, Nick Arnstein (Omar Sharif), is another story.

673500.title: The Ambushers
673500.description: When an experimental flying saucer is brought down in Mexico, secret agent Matt Helm is sent to find it and keep it from falling into enemy hands.

673500.title: Shockproof
673500.description: Jenny Marsh (Patricia Knight) is a hard-luck dame who's just finished five years in the slammer for killing a man. Jenny's not exactly the murdering type -- she did the deed while defending her jailbird lover, Harry (John Baragrey), which is probably one reason she's attracted the attention of her parole officer, Griff Marat (Cornel Wilde). In fact, Griff is so taken with Jenny that he gets her a job caring for his ailing mother, but although Jenny tries to fly right, she's not yet over Harry.

673500.title: 5 Against the House
673500.description: At Harold's Club in Reno, what begins as a joke for four college friends ends as a reality, when a heist goes ahead with disastrous results.

673500.title: The Chase
673500.description: This steamy pot-boiler follows the intrigues surrounding an escaped convict who attempts to return to the small southern town where he grew up.

673500.title: A Night to Remember
673500.description: In this suspenseful comedy, Nancy Troy (Loretta Young) and her mystery-author husband, Jeff (Brian Aherne), move into a dark basement apartment in New York City's Greenwich Village, in hopes of stirring up writing inspiration. When their neighbors begin acting oddly and one of them turns up dead, Nancy and Jeff must uncover a murder mystery in their own building, with a number of suspects lurking about, including the creepy Mrs. Devoe (Gale Sondergaard).

673500.title: It Happened to Jane
673500.description: When a shipment of expired shellfish arrives to her New England lobstery, Jane Osgood decides to take a capitalist railroad tycoon to court.

673500.title: Her Husband's Affairs
673500.description: Advertising executive William Weldon (Franchot Tone) narrowly averts career implosion when his clever wife, Margaret (Lucille Ball), helps him save an important advertising account.
