screenpix.us.description: A Las Vegas singer (Mamie Van Doren) plans an armored-car robbery with her husband's (Lee Van Cleef) ex-cellmate (Gerald Mohr). (Crime drama) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: The Organization
screenpix.us.description: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

screenpix.us.title: The Killer Is Loose
screenpix.us.description: Humble bank teller Leon Poole (Wendell Corey) participates in a heist that doesn't go as planned. When police surround his apartment, there's a shoot-out, during which Detective Sam Wagner (Joseph Cotten) unwittingly kills Poole's wife. Poole is subsequently captured and jailed, but three years later he's back out on the street and hell-bent on revenge. Wanting the punishment to fit the crime, he vows that he won't kill Wagner -- just his wife (Rhonda Fleming). (Thriller) - 1956

screenpix.us.title: The Young Savages
screenpix.us.description: After a Puerto Rican teen is murdered by three white adolescents, the case comes to Assistant District Attorney Hank Bell (Burt Lancaster). Realizing that he used to date the mother (Shelley Winters) of one of the suspects, he wonders if the boy is his son. Despite Bell's personal involvement, the district attorney (Edward Andrews) keeps him on the case. However, as Bell discovers street gang involvement in the case, he and his wife (Dina Merrill) begin to face physical threats. (Drama, Thriller) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: The Large Rope
screenpix.us.description: An innocent ex-con becomes a two-time loser when he finds himself the scapegoat in the murder of a disreputable female. (Crime drama) - 1953

screenpix.us.title: Cast a Giant Shadow
screenpix.us.description: In this fact-based film, distinguished U.S. Army Col. David Marcus (Kirk Douglas) is enlisted by the Israelis to perform the difficult task of preparing their fledgling nation for battle against the Arabs. Before long, he feuds with the local leaders, quits his post and goes back home to his pregnant wife (Angie Dickinson) in the United States. However, Marcus, who is Jewish himself, soon has a crisis of faith and decides to return to duty to help the untrained Israelis form an army. (War) - 1966

screenpix.us.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
screenpix.us.description: When popular singer Dino (Dean Martin) stops for gas in a small town near Las Vegas, mechanic Barney (Cliff Osmond) disables his car. Barney, who writes songs with local teacher Orville (Ray Walston), wants Dino to sing some of their compositions. Orville invites Dino over, but sends his wife, Zelda (Felicia Farr), away so Dino can't hit on her. He then hires prostitute Polly (Kim Novak) to play his wife. Meanwhile, Zelda goes to a bar, where she gets drunk and eventually meets a lonely Dino. (Romantic comedy) - 1964

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleep-overs in 'Theo's Big Night Out', then in 'The Bodyguard', Alvin decides he needs a personal bodyguard, and trains Theodore for the job. (S3, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin is convinced his mojo was in a cap he gave away in 'Mojo Missing', then in 'Who's The Animal', Alvin finds himself mistaken for a Tasmanian devil during a costume visit to the zoo. (S1, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The boys get stuck with Miss Miller as a babysitter in 'Temporary Mom', then in 'Tee For Two', Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and gets paired up with Miss Smith. (S3, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon is alarmed to discover he's been tagging private property in his sleep in 'Simsky', then in 'Lucky Day', Alvin's luck goes from bad to worse after Theodore finds a four-leaf clover. (S3, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The girls are remembering their home in 'The Tree House', then in 'Saving Simon', Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to a boarding school, and try to keep him at home. (S1, ep 15)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a film in 'Lights Camera Uh-Oh', then in 'Wax Dave', The Chipmunks fear Dave is in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a statue! (S2, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices. (S3, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Simon have a secret club in 'Mysterions', and in 'The Crow That Ate My Homework', Dave promises to take Alvin to a park if he gets a good grade on his test, but a crow steals it. (S4, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The boy's imaginations run wild when Dave disappears in 'Taken', then in 'The Flying Beast', Alvin tries to convince Dave that he's being hunted by a flying beast. (S5, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers in 'Sister Act', then in 'Lil' T', Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a mega-hit! (S1, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies in 'Members Only', then in 'The New Kid', Alvin befriends a lonely new kidl, but the new student may not be who he says he is. (S2, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it. (S3, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his destiny in 'Theodore's Calling', then in 'Clumsy Jeanette', Jeanette's new glasses cause a clumsy change. (S4, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin's convinced Dave will abandon him in the desert in 'Deserted', and in 'The Great Snack Off', Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences. (S5, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand. (S5, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor has prepared a cake for a Bake-Off in 'Let Them Eat Crumbs', and in 'Who Ghosts There', worried that Dave will move the family to his dream house, the boys make it seem haunted. (S1, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin borrows Simon's invisibility suit in 'Overlooked', and in 'Wish Upon a Star', when Theodore makes a wish, the Chipmunks try to learn what it is, so that they can make it come true. (S2, ep 21)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: My Sister the Weirdo: Jeanette wants to give a toast to Brittany at her upcoming party. But Jeanette is so shy, she seeks advice from the most confident person she knows - Alvin! (S1, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin Management: When Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, a therapist moves in to help Dave control his anger. (S4, ep 8a)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Double Dangus: The chipmunks discover Officer Dangus has a twin brother that's a bully and encourage Dangus to stand up to him. (S4, ep 20b)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Time Traveller's Party: Simon tells Alvin time travel is impossible, until a man from the future shows up at their home. (S5, ep 8b)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon's plant experiment creates a growing monster in 'A Rose By Another Name', then in 'Queen Bee', Brittany admires bees after living as one. (S3, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Jeanette and the Chipmunks rescue a chimpanzee in 'Chimpmania', then in 'Dad Jokes', Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes, but will Alvin tell him he's not funny? (S4, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin takes Theodore's drums, so Theodore mimics him in 'Little Drummer Boy', then in 'Special Ingredient, Alvin sabotages Theodore's pancakes. (S5, ep 18)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave discovers he didn't graduate from high school and ends up in class with Alvin in 'Back to School', then in 'Bromance', Simon has found a new best friend, but then gets ditched. (S1, ep 16)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits in 'Missing Miss Smith', then in 'Monster Madness', Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie. (S2, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany face a spooky mystery in 'School Alone', then in 'It Came From Outer Space', Alvin's fake meteor causes chaos. (S3, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The chipmunks think Dave is in danger in 'The Exchange Student', then in 'Crystal Ball Birthday', Annie and Amber plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor. (S4, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor enters a knight competition in 'A Knight's Tail', and then in 'Dreambomber', Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them. (S5, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle royale in 'Bubble Wrap', and in 'Chess Mate', a cute girl joins the chess club, so Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him to play so he can join too. (S5, ep 21)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon's game launch is disrupted by Jeanette's changes in 'The Return of Thornbergaupht', then in 'Squashed', Alvin ropes Dave into playing squash. (S5, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Road Warrior / My Fair Chipette: More adventures with the pint-sized chipmunks. And Alvin, who is also a chipmunk, and therefore of broadly similar size.

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks don't want to perform in the school play in 'The Curse of MacBeth', then in 'Zeela The Great', Simon's robot Geizmo becomes jealous of Jeanette's robot Zeela. (S5, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor and Jeanette wonder if Brittany would care for them in 'Sick as a Chipmunk', then in 'Instant Gram, Dave makes several embarrassing posts on social media, and Alvin tries to help. (S4, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Jeanette and the Chipmunks rescue a chimpanzee in 'Chimpmania', then in 'Dad Jokes', Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes, but will Alvin tell him he's not funny? (S4, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin wants the lead role in a play in 'Best in Shoe', then in 'Royal Pain', Brittany becomes convinced she's a long lost princess, and carries her new royal status a little too far. (S4, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The chipmunks think Dave is in danger in 'The Exchange Student', then in 'Crystal Ball Birthday', Annie and Amber plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor. (S4, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Coach Dobkins challenges Miss Smith to a baseball game in 'The C Team', then in 'Father Daughter Dance', The Chipettes each want Dave to be their date for the dance. (S3, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn. (S3, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany dreams of being a fashion designer in 'The Devil Wears Rodentia', then in 'Career Day', Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously. (S3, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon's plant experiment creates a growing monster in 'A Rose By Another Name', then in 'Queen Bee', Brittany admires bees after living as one. (S3, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin must prove that alien life exists in 'Across the Universe', and in 'Britt's Picks', Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog, and vows to get him back? (S3, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

(Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: Chocolat
showtimewomen.us.description: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. (Drama, Romance) - 2000

showtimewomen.us.title: Mean Girls
showtimewomen.us.description: Cady Heron enrolls at North Shore High School near Chicago after living in Africa. She interacts with Regina George, a prominent student who previously dated Aaron Samuels. Conflict arises when Heron develops an interest in Samuels, leading George to feign a friendship with Heron while attempting to maintain her relationship with Samuels. Both students engage in competitive social behavior that affects the student body. (Comedy) - 2004

showtimewomen.us.title: Body Cam
showtimewomen.us.description: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

showtimewomen.us.title: The Ring Two
showtimewomen.us.description: A female journalist (Naomi Watts) must prevent evil Samara from taking possession of her son's (David Dorfman) soul. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2005

showtimewomen.us.title: The Uninvited
showtimewomen.us.description: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2009

showtimewomen.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
showtimewomen.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance) - 1999

showtimewomen.us.title: Fatal Attraction
showtimewomen.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 1987

showtimewomen.us.title: A Perfect Murder
showtimewomen.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

showtimewomen.us.title: Double Jeopardy
showtimewomen.us.description: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Mystery) - 1999

showtimewomen.us.title: Basic Instinct
showtimewomen.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

showtimewomen.us.title: Asylum
showtimewomen.us.description: An administrator's bored wife (Natasha Richardson) begins a torrid affair with an institutionalized artist (Marton Csokas) who beat his wife to death. (Drama) - 2005

showtimewomen.us.title: Organ Trail
showtimewomen.us.description: Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits. (Western, Horror, Thriller) - 2023

showtimewomen.us.title: Red Eye
showtimewomen.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

showtimewomen.us.title: You Can Count on Me
showtimewomen.us.description: Sammy is a single mother who is extremely protective of her 8-year-old son. She is satisfied with living in the small town she grew up in and working in a local bank. When her brother Terry visits he fits the void in the life of both her and her son. Temporarily free of the constraints of single motherhood she begins to break free of her normal routine. In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt. (Drama) - 2000

showtimewomen.us.title: Sabrina
showtimewomen.us.description: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 1995

showtimewomen.us.title: The Bodyguard
showtimewomen.us.description: Best-selling pop diva Rachel Marron has a stalker whose obsession has risen to the level of disturbing threats. At the urging of her manager, Rachel hires former Secret Service agent Frank Farmer as her bodyguard. Initially resented and treated with disdain for his hard-nosed security procedures, Farmer soon becomes an integral part of Rachel's inner circle. As they spend more time together, client and protector become closer still. (Drama, Romance) - 1992

showtimewomen.us.title: Days of Thunder
showtimewomen.us.description: In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes). (Action, Drama, Romance) - 1990

screenpixvoices.us.title: Bamboo Gods and Iron Men
screenpixvoices.us.description: Filipino gangsters hound a trio (James Iglehart, Shirley Washington, Chiquito) whose carved Buddha hides something to control the world. - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Savage Sisters
screenpixvoices.us.description: Three women (Gloria Hendry, Cheri Caffaro, Rosanna Ortiz) of three races join the fundraising part of an island revolution. - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Act of Vengeance
screenpixvoices.us.description: Five women learn martial arts in order to punish a rapist (Peter Brown) who wears a hockey mask. - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Original Gangstas
screenpixvoices.us.description: Former gang members return to depressed Gary, Ind., to quell violence perpetrated by their successors. - 1996

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hammer
screenpixvoices.us.description: A brawling dockworker (Fred Williamson) becomes a heavyweight contender, backed by a crime boss fronting for the mob. - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
screenpixvoices.us.description: Cohorts turn brutal while helping a man (Fred Williamson) avenge his brother's death in a racially divided town. - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Soda Cracker
screenpixvoices.us.description: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner. - 1989

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hell up in Harlem
screenpixvoices.us.description: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world. (Crime drama) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: Black Caesar
screenpixvoices.us.description: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost. (Crime drama) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hammer
screenpixvoices.us.description: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on. (Crime drama, Action) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
screenpixvoices.us.description: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. During his stay, he decides to revive his brother's nightclub business. However, this venture quickly uncovers the thinly veiled racism and corruption that run rampant in the town. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates. (Action) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: J.D.'s Revenge
screenpixvoices.us.description: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elijah Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago. (Horror) - 1976

screenpixvoices.us.title: Sugar Hill
screenpixvoices.us.description: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers. (Horror) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Blacula
screenpixvoices.us.description: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail. (Horror) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Scream Blacula Scream
screenpixvoices.us.description: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge. (Horror) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: The First Power
screenpixvoices.us.description: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan. (Horror) - 1990

showtimenext.us.description: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: Office Christmas Party
showtimenext.us.description: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2016

showtimenext.us.title: Love and Monsters
showtimenext.us.description: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy) - 2020

showtimenext.us.title: The Death of Stalin
showtimenext.us.description: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? (Dark comedy, Historical drama) - 2017

showtimenext.us.title: The Layover
showtimenext.us.description: Best friends Kate and Meg find themselves competing for the same man while waiting for their plane to take off from St. Louis. (Comedy) - 2017

showtimenext.us.title: An Unfinished Life
showtimenext.us.description: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. (Drama) - 2005

showtimenext.us.title: Firestarter
showtimenext.us.description: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop." (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1984

showtimenext.us.title: The Lego Movie
showtimenext.us.description: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet who always follows the rules, is mistakenly identified as an extraordinary being and the key to saving the world. He finds himself drafted into a fellowship of strangers who are on a mission to stop an evil tyrant's plans to conquer the world. Unfortunately for Emmet, he is hopelessly and hilariously unprepared for such a task, but he'll give it his all nonetheless. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2014

showtimenext.us.title: Beastly
showtimenext.us.description: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love. (Fantasy, Romance, Drama) - 2011

showtimenext.us.title: Parasite
showtimenext.us.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama) - 2019

showtimenext.us.title: Side Effects
showtimenext.us.description: For four years, Emily Taylor (Rooney Mara) has awaited the release of her husband, Martin (Channing Tatum), from being imprisoned for insider trading. Finally, Martin comes home, but Emily feels just as bad as she did when he was incarcerated, and she sinks into a deep depression. After her failed suicide attempt, psychiatrist Jonathan Banks (Jude Law) prescribes a series of medications. When those don't work, he gives Emily a new medication -- but the drug leads to ruined lives and death. (Drama, Thriller) - 2013

showtimenext.us.title: The Contractor
showtimenext.us.description: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. (Action, Thriller) - 2022

showtimenext.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
showtimenext.us.description: Along with his girlfriend (Michelle Monaghan), a private detective (Casey Affleck) takes on the difficult task of searching for a kidnapped girl in Boston. During his investigation, he must deal with the girl's aunt, a disapproving lawman (Morgan Freeman) and a drug dealer. (Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2007

showtimenext.us.title: Parasite
showtimenext.us.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama) - 2019

showtimenext.us.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
showtimenext.us.description: Long ago, Abraham Van Helsing (Christopher Plummer) imprisoned the infamous Count Dracula (Gerard Butler) within a vault inside Carfax Abbey. In the present day, Van Helsing relies on Dracula's immortal blood to remain alive. But then thieves break into the vault and steal the vampire's coffin, thinking it contains something valuable. Liberated from his prison, Dracula seizes the opportunity to escape, but Van Helsing sets out to banish him to the crypt once again. (Horror, Action, Fantasy, Thriller, Romance) - 2000

showtimenext.us.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
showtimenext.us.description: After a band of medical students receives a decaying but living body reported to be the vampire Count Dracula (Stephen Billington), they set out to harness his power and immortality. As a bonus, their mentor, Lowell (Craig Sheffer), claims that there is a mysterious donor willing to fund their research. During the study, student Elizabeth Blaine (Diane Neal) injures herself on the vampire's tooth and starts to feel strange. Soon, vampire hunter Father Uffizi (Jason Scott Lee) is on their trail. (Horror) - 2003

showtimenext.us.title: Marshmallow
showtimenext.us.description: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp. (Horror, Thriller) - 2025

showtimenext.us.title: The Woman in Black
showtimenext.us.description: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy) - 2012

showtimenext.us.title: 16 Shots
showtimenext.us.description: A Chicago police officer is charged with murder after the shooting of Laquan McDonald. (Documentary) - 2019

showtimenext.us.title: The Ring
showtimenext.us.description: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2002

showtimenext.us.title: Crawlspace
showtimenext.us.description: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. (Thriller) - 2022

showtimenext.us.title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
showtimenext.us.description: The first of three dark tales involves resentful student Bellingham (Steve Buscemi) looking to an Egyptian mummy for help in settling some scores. Then, hit man Halston (David Johansen) is contracted to kill a cat that has terrorized and even killed members of an extremely wealthy family. Lastly, struggling artist Preston (James Remar) witnesses a demon commit a bizarre murder on a city street, but agrees to keep it a secret when the devilish being promises wealth in return for his silence. (Horror) - 1990

showtimenext.us.title: Band Aid

(Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1999

showtimeextreme.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
showtimeextreme.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Ghost in the Shell
showtimeextreme.us.description: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
showtimeextreme.us.description: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

showtimeextreme.us.title: Dunkirk
showtimeextreme.us.description: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. (War, Historical drama, Action) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
showtimeextreme.us.description: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction. (War, Drama) - 1979

showtimeextreme.us.title: Shutter Island
showtimeextreme.us.description: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. (Thriller, Mystery, Drama) - 2010

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Crossing Guard
showtimeextreme.us.description: For six excruciating years, Freddy Gale (Jack Nicholson) has fantasized about taking bloody revenge on John Booth (David Morse), the drunk driver responsible for the traffic accident that killed his daughter. On the last day of Booth's prison sentence, a grief-stricken Gale informs his ex-wife, Mary (Anjelica Huston), of his intentions, then follows Booth to a mobile home in the suburbs. There, with hands shaking, Gale draws his gun -- and steps into a dark and uncertain future. (Drama) - 1995

showtimeextreme.us.title: Below
showtimeextreme.us.description: The submarine U.S.S. Manta had a perfect record until the mysterious death of its captain. The next-in-command, Lt. Richard Brice (Bruce Greenwood) is determined to steer his disheartened crew back to safety. But after three battle survivors board the sub, bizarre and frightening things begin to happen. As the tale unfolds, and crew members begin to disappear, Ensign Douglas O'Dell (Matthew Davis) must piece together the puzzles of the submarine's past before it is too late to resurface alive. (Thriller) - 2002

showtimeextreme.us.title: Winchester
showtimeextreme.us.description: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy) - 2018

showtimeextreme.us.title: House at the End of the Street
showtimeextreme.us.description: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. (Thriller, Horror) - 2012

showtimeextreme.us.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
showtimeextreme.us.description: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition. (Comedy) - 2004

showtimeextreme.us.title: Wild Wild West
showtimeextreme.us.description: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction) - 1999

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After the three young Baudelaire siblings are left orphaned by a fire in their mansion, they are carted off to live with their distant relative, Count Olaf. Unfortunately, Olaf is a cruel, scheming man only after the inheritance that the eldest Baudelaire, Violet, is set to receive. The children escape and find shelter with their quirky Uncle Monty and, subsequently, their phobic Aunt Josephine, but Olaf is never far behind.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Spencer goes back into the fantastical world of Jumanji, pals Martha, Fridge and Bethany re-enter the game to bring him home. But everything about Jumanji is about to change, as they soon discover more obstacles and more danger to overcome.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Matilda
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Matilda is a gifted child, more gifted than any other, but her parents won't let her go to school. She teaches herself for years by going to the library and reading everything she sees. Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Gabby's dollhouse, her most prized possession, ends up in the hands of an eccentric cat lady named Vera, she sets off on an adventure through the real world to get the Gabby Cats back together before it's too late.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Goosebumps
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young kid teams up with the niece of young adult horror author RL Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Greendale, Maryland.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Goosebumps 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Best friends meet, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life, just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save the town from Slappy's wicked plan.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Wicked: For Good
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Minecraft Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Bean: The Ultimate Disaster Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mr Bean has somehow managed to get a job as a security guard. His latest assignment finds him travelling to America as an art expert, looking after the famous 'Whistler's Mother' painting as it is transported from Britain to a posh new Los Angeles museum. The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Mr Bean's Holiday
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hook
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Witches
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Creepy fairy tale following the fortunes of a young orphan who becomes embroiled in a supernatural adventure. Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

starzencorefamily.us.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
starzencorefamily.us.description: Secretly in love with his friend (Kate Bosworth), a supermarket manager (Topher Grace) becomes jealous when she meets a famous actor (Josh Duhamel). - 2004

starzencorefamily.us.title: The Back-up Plan
starzencorefamily.us.description: A single woman (Jennifer Lopez) meets the man (Alex O'Loughlin) of her dreams on the same day she becomes pregnant through artificial insemination. - 2010

starzencorefamily.us.title: The Ladybug
starzencorefamily.us.description: A seven-spotted ladybug dreams of escaping its glass cage and finding the Golden Canyon, a legendary insect utopia. - 2018

starzencorefamily.us.title: House of D
starzencorefamily.us.description: In the present, artist Tom Warshaw recalls his traumatic coming of age. As a 13-year-old growing up in New York City in 1973, Tom hangs out with Pappass, a mentally disabled man. With Tom's mother battling depression after the death of her husband, the young boy is left to his own devices. When Tom develops a crush on schoolmate Melissa, Pappass feels abandoned and begins behaving erratically. (Comedy drama) - 2004

starzencorefamily.us.title: Monster Zone
starzencorefamily.us.description: Transferred to a boarding school, a 15-year-old accidentally opens a portal that unleashes monsters from another dimension. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2020

starzencorefamily.us.title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
starzencorefamily.us.description: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. When Angel is kidnapped by a mad treasure hunter, Mindy and her school friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold. (Drama) - 2024

starzencorefamily.us.title: Morning Glory
starzencorefamily.us.description: Newly hired as a producer on a national morning-news program called "Daybreak," Becky Fuller (Rachel McAdams) decides to revitalize the low-rated show by bringing in legendary anchorman Mike Pomeroy (Harrison Ford). Pomeroy, however, refuses to do puff pieces like celebrity gossip and fashion, and clashes with his co-host (Diane Keaton). Meanwhile, Becky's romance with a colleague begins to unravel, leaving her struggling to save her relationship, her job and the show. (Drama, Romance, Comedy) - 2010

starzencorefamily.us.title: The Dog Who Saved Summer
starzencorefamily.us.description: After their dog Zeus ruins a party, George takes him to an obedience school run by a no-nonsense instructor. When Zeus manages to fail every test, he seeks help from a trainer with special techniques. (Children, Comedy) - 2015

starzencorefamily.us.title: Bandslam
starzencorefamily.us.description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own. (Musical comedy, Romantic comedy) - 2009

starzencorewesterns.us.description: A strong-willed woman takes Flint prisoner when he asks permission to cross her land.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Wagon Train - The Jess MacAbee Story
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Flint meets a mother who wants him to marry one of her daughters.

starzencorewesterns.us.description: Two sideshow hypnotists, The Great Reardon and his wife, use their powers to fleece a gold-mine owner after Hardie hires them to serve as entertainment at a Wells Fargo celebration.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Lawman - Girl From Grantsville
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Marshal Troop gives advice to his young deputy regarding Jenny.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Lawman - The Surface of Truth
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Marshal Dan Troop uses an Indian test to determine a Cheyenne's wife's death.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Cheyenne - One-Way Ticket
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Cheyenne brings his prisoner, Cole Younger, to trial despite the threat of killers and romantic women.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Cheyenne - The Bad Penny
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Poetic death warnings are mailed to town residents, and Cheyenne decides a play is the trick to catch the conscience of the murderess.

starzencorewesterns.us.description: Beau wins half a casino and an entire family feud.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Maverick - The Witch of Hound Dog
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Bart meets a Tennessee witch.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Sitting Bull
starzencorewesterns.us.description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). - 1954

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Gone Are the Days
starzencorewesterns.us.description: With his days winding down, an aging gunman sets out on a quest to perform one last good deed, hoping to save his soul. (Western) - 2018

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown. (Western) - 1949

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Bad Man's River
starzencorewesterns.us.description: An outlaw and two con men attempt to relieve the Mexican government of $1 million. Once the scam is completed, they have to avoid the attentions of, amongst others, the Mexican army and Billy the Kid - all of whom are eager to claim the cash for themselves. (Western) - 1971

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Under California Stars
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. themoviechannel.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: The Foreigner
themoviechannel.us.description: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Top Gun
themoviechannel.us.description: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 1986

themoviechannel.us.title: The Terminal
themoviechannel.us.description: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal? (Comedy drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Up in the Air
themoviechannel.us.description: An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Blue Valentine
themoviechannel.us.description: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage. (Drama, Romance) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Sliver
themoviechannel.us.description: Well-to-do book editor Carly Norris (Sharon Stone) moves into a luxury apartment building before learning that a number of female tenants have been dying in grisly ways, allegedly at the hands of a serial killer. Soon, Norris becomes romantically involved with one of the prime suspects, building owner Zeke Hawkins (William Baldwin). The other suspect is her neighbor, writer Jack Landsford (Tom Berenger). Unsure of whom to trust, Norris must uncover the truth before she is the next victim. (Thriller) - 1993

themoviechannel.us.title: Rumpelstiltskin
themoviechannel.us.description: A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul. (Horror) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
themoviechannel.us.description: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive. (Comedy) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The First Wives Club
themoviechannel.us.description: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. (Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: He's Just Not That Into You
themoviechannel.us.description: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna. (Romantic comedy) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
themoviechannel.us.description: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. (Animated, Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Daddy's Home
themoviechannel.us.description: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family. (Comedy) - 2015

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mark of the Vampire

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Devil Doll
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Paul (Lionel Barrymore) is wrongfully convicted of robbery and murder, and breaks out of prison using a scientist's shrinking invention. - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Freaks
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sideshow performers punish acrobat Cleopatra (Olga Baclanova) for humiliating their friend, tiny Hans. - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Becoming Hitchcock -- The Legacy of Blackmail
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Highlighting the birth of the Hitchcock Touch at a period when talking pictures first emerged and exploring trademark themes like murder, suspense and blondes. - 2024

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Blackmail
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Longden) deals with a blackmailer (Donald Calthrop) who knows that the lawman's fiancée (Anny Ondra) killed an artist. - 1929

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The 39 Steps
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While on vacation in London, Canadian Richard Hannay becomes embroiled in an international spy ring related to the mysterious "39 steps." Then he meets agent Annabella Smith, who is soon killed in his apartment. He must elude the police, who are hunting him for murder, while he tries to stop Professor Jordan from sending secrets out of the country. Hannay is assisted by Pamela, an unwilling accomplice who discovers the truth. (Thriller, Mystery) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dial M for Murder
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Ex-tennis pro Tony Wendice (Ray Milland) wants to have his wealthy wife, Margot (Grace Kelly), murdered so he can get his hands on her inheritance. When he discovers her affair with Mark Halliday (Robert Cummings), he comes up with the perfect plan to kill her. He blackmails an old acquaintance into carrying out the murder, but the carefully-orchestrated set-up goes awry, and Margot stays alive. Now Wendice must frantically scheme to outwit the police and avoid having his plot detected. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: North by Northwest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This classic suspense film finds New York City ad executive Roger O. Thornhill (Cary Grant) pursued by ruthless spy Phillip Vandamm (James Mason) after Thornhill is mistaken for a government agent. Hunted relentlessly by Vandamm's associates, the harried Thornhill ends up on a cross-country journey, meeting the beautiful and mysterious Eve Kendall (Eva Marie Saint) along the way. Soon Vandamm's henchmen close in on Thornhill, resulting in a number of iconic action sequences. (Thriller) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Eva Marie Saint: Live From the TCM Classic Film Festival
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An interview with Eve Marie Saint, concerning her life and career, taped at the TCM Classic Film Festival in April 2013. (Special, Entertainment, Interview) - 2014-03-31

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Science fiction) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Lost City - Living Dead-Men
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes. (Drama, Adventure)

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dr. Gillespie's New Assistant
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The hospital superiors order aging Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) to hire an assistant, so the old physician reluctantly agrees to choose between upstarts Dr. Adams (Van Johnson), Dr. Lee Wong How (Keye Luke) and Dr. Lindsey (Richard Quine). Instead of testing their scientific smarts, Gillespie decides to show the young men that medical school alone cannot make someone into a good caregiver. Eventually, the three hopefuls realize they should take the elderly doctor's advice to heart. (Drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Looney Tunes - Hyde and Go Tweet
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sylvester chases Tweety as he flies outside the office of Dr. Jekyll; Tweety ends up in the Hyde formula, transforming him into a giant. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 1960-05-14

turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sylvester Cat gets chased into Dr. Jekyll's lab by a pair of canines. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 1954-05-08

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Barkleys of Broadway
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Josh (Fred Astaire) and Dinah Barkley (Ginger Rogers) are a famous musical theater duo, but an argument on the opening night of their newest Broadway show reveals previously unspoken resentments. Dinah feels overshadowed by Josh, so when flirtatious playwright Jacques Pierre Barredout (Jacques François) suggests she play the lead in his new drama about Sarah Bernhardt, she separates from Josh and endeavors to become a serious actress. Can producer Ezra Miller (Oscar Levant) reunite the duo? (Musical) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lured
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sandra Carpenter (Lucille Ball) is a London-based dancer who is distraught to learn that her friend has disappeared. Soon after the disappearance, she's approached by Harley Temple (Charles Coburn), a police investigator who believes her friend has been murdered by a serial killer who uses personal ads to find his victims. Temple hatches a plan to catch the killer using Sandra as bait, and Sandra agrees to help. But complications arise when Sandra becomes engaged to a nightclub owner. (Thriller) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Gentle Dr. Jekyll (Spencer Tracy) experiments with human nature, believing that each person has both good and evil sides that can be brought forth chemically. Jekyll tests a serum on himself, releasing his vicious alter ego, Mr. Hyde, on 19th-century London. Prowling the town, Hyde ventures to a music hall and encounters Ivy (Ingrid Bergman), whom he takes forcibly as his mistress. When the serum's effects wear off, Jekyll vows never to take it again. But Hyde is not gone for good. (Horror) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Soylent Green
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In a densely overpopulated, starving New York City of the future, NYPD detective Robert Thorn investigates the murder of an executive at rations manufacturer Soylent Corporation. With the help of elderly academic Solomon "Sol" Roth, Thorn begins to make real progress -- until the governor mysteriously pulls the plug. Obsessed with the mystery, Thorn steps out from behind the badge and launches his own investigation into the murder. (Science fiction, Mystery) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Rear Window
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A newspaper photographer with a broken leg passes time recuperating by observing his neighbors through his window. He sees what he believes to be a murder, and decides to solve the crime himself. With the help of his nurse and wife, he tries to catch the murderer without being killed himself. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Paper Moon
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Real-life father and daughter Ryan and Tatum O'Neal team up as slick con-artists Moses Pray and Addie Loggins in the 1930s Kansas. When Moze is unexpectedly saddled with getting the 9-year-old Addie to relatives in Missouri after the death of her mother, his attempt to dupe her out of her money backfires, and he's forced to take her on as a partner. Swindling their way through farm country, the pair is nearly done in by a burlesque dancer and an angry bootlegger. (Comedy) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Chicago Syndicate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An accountant (Dennis O'Keefe) uses microfilm to nail a crime czar (Paul Stewart) for income-tax evasion. (Crime drama) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Summer of '42
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Teenage Herman Raucher (Gary Grimes), summering on Nantucket Island with his sex-obsessed pals Oscy (Jerry Houser) and Benji (Oliver Conant) during World War II, meets Dorothy (Jennifer O'Neill), a newlywed in her 20s whose husband is off at war. As his friends awkwardly attempt to woo girls their own age, Herman slowly befriends the older woman and finds himself becoming increasingly in love with her, until a sudden tragedy changes their lives forever. (Romance) - 1971

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Class of '44
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two friends (Gary Grimes, Jerry Houser) go to college and another (Oliver Conant) joins the Marines in this sequel to "Summer of '42." (Drama) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Night Digger
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Middle-aged Maura Prince (Patricia Neal) lives a lonely life caring for her debilitated mother (Pamela Brown) in a mansion. When mysterious biker Billy Jarvis (Nicholas Clay) arrives at their door looking for work as a handyman, Maura is suspicious of the strange visitor. While Billy proves himself to be kind, he has a dark secret: he's a killer. Despite learning that Billy may be involved in a series of recent murders, Maura cannot help but fall in love with him. (Horror) - 1971

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Night Watch
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Ellen Wheeler (Elizabeth Taylor) is an unhappy housewife who settles her fraying nerves with alcohol while staring out her window. When she witnesses what she thinks is a murder through a neighbor's window, she calls the police, who find nothing when they investigate. With her neglectful husband (Laurence Harvey) skeptical and unsupportive, Ellen turns to her friend Sarah (Billie Whitelaw), who is slightly more receptive as the pair attempt to get to the bottom of the mystery. (Mystery, Horror, Thriller) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Chicago Syndicate

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Singin' in the Rain

Don is on top of the world until Lina finds out. (Musical comedy) - 1952

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: How Do They Really Do It?

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
