BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E1 Battlefield: Part 1 As UNIT are transporting a nuclear warhead around Carbury, knights in armour arrive to contine waging a war that began thousands of years ago, but in a wholly different dimension.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E2 Battlefield: Part 2 The Doctor and Ace explore King Arthur’s spaceship deep under Lake Vortigern, while Brigadier Lethbridge-Stewart arrives in Carbury where he encounters Morgaine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E3 Battlefield: Part 3 Furious at her inability to find and engage Arthur in battle, Morgaine threatens to unleash the Destroyer upon the planet unless the Doctor gives her what she wants.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E4 Battlefield: Part 4 The Brigadier slays the Destroyer while Morgaine takes control of UNIT's nuclear warhead and prepares to start a countdown that will destroy Earth forever.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E2 Warriors of the Deep: Part 2 The Silurians and Sea Devils send the Myrka in as a spearhead to the invasion of the Seabase, whilst Nilson and Doctor Solow work to bring the entire Bloc down.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E3 Warriors of the Deep: Part 3 As Vorshak’s crew are cut down one by one by Sauvix's Sea Devil Warriors, the Doctor is running out of ways to broker a peace between mammal and reptile.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E5 The Happiness Patrol: Part 1 The Happiness Patrol walk the streets of Terra Alpha, destroying all the killjoys, on the orders of the despotic Helen A. And in the Kandy Kitchen, something terrible lurks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E6 The Happiness Patrol: Part 2 The Doctor escapes the Kandyman while Ace meets the Pipe People. Later, fleeing for her life, Ace is captured and selected to audition for the Happiness Patrol.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E7 The Happiness Patrol: Part 3 As the Doctor leads the Pipe People towards reclaiming their world, Helen A faces betrayal from those closest to her and the Kandyman comes to a sticky end.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E8 Silver Nemesis: Part 1 A group of Neo-Nazis in South America are seeking the Nemesis Statue – as is a shuttle full of Cybermen and the mysterious Lady Peinforte from the 17th century.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E9 Silver Nemesis: Part 2 The Cybermen have the Nemesis Statue but Lady Peinforte and Richard fight back because they were prepared with gold-tipped arrows and De Flores still has a plan to set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E10 Silver Nemesis: Part 3 The Nemesis Statue is alive, thanks to Lady Peinforte's insanity, and with De Flores's Nazi’s wiped out by the Cybermen, Nemesis claims it has secrets to reveal.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E11 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 1 Bellboy and Flowerchild escape the Psychic Circus but are pursued by the Chief Clown. The Doctor and Ace meet other visitors to Segonax, some of whom are not what they seem.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E12 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 2 The mysterious family watching the acts within the ring, dissatisfied with Nord, destroy him. Captain Cook goes to extreme measures to ensure he’s not the next to displease them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E13 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 3 Ace and Bellboy team up to stop the Chief Clown while the Doctor realises that he is next into the ring. The Captain has another trick up his sleeve and shows Mags's true colours.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E14 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 4 The Gods of Ragnarok are revealed and while waiting for Ace to escape the Chief Clown, the Doctor must entertain them as long as possible in the dimension of the Dark Circus.

But when she becomes the latest target of the Butcher, the town's infamous serial killer, her senior year becomes the least of her worries. When the Butcher's mystical dagger causes him and Millie to magically switch bodies, the frightened teen learns she has just 24 hours to get her identity back before she looks like a middle-aged maniac forever. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. kolr.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. kolr.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under ᴺᵉʷ

This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

kolr.us.title: Hope in the Wild ᴺᵉʷ

wrsp.us.description: Greg Peterson has been covering farm equipment auctions for various industry magazines for more than 20 years and did the same during six seasons of RFD's "Machinery Show." Now Peterson has his own show, which shares its title with his nickname: "Machinery Pete." Each episode features Peterson traveling to a farm machinery auction, where he meets some of the people who attend the sales where items like tractors and skid steers are sold. He also provides his analysis of current and historical trends in the used equipment market and answers viewer questions about what their equipment is worth in the Ask Machinery Pete segment. discoverywest.us.title: Homestead Rescue : Kentucky Calamity
discoverywest.us.description: S10 E06 A Kentucky homestead, built in the historical remnants of an old mining town, faces biblical flooding; Marty revives the original barn, Matt devises a livestock escape pod and Misty conceives her first floating greenhouse.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E09 Monsoon Millions Under the threat of severe thunderstorms and floods during monsoon season in Arizona, Freddy and Juan must not only fix the group of friends' operation, but also race to recover enough gold to stop the investor from pulling out.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E08 Zeroes to Golden Heroes An Oregon miner calls Freddy and Juan to help save his mine to pass it on to his greenhorn son; they give the son some valuable know-how, but discover the property has been completely mined out; an all-out prospecting hunt to save their dream.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
discoverywest.us.description: S03 E09 Home Is Where the Gold Is A family sells everything to purchase a 150-acre gold-rich property to mine and homestead; as their families grow, their gold production does not; shutdowns and broken equipment send Freddy and Juan's plans off track, forcing all-new ingenuity.

discoverywest.us.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E01 Living Life on the Edge A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush : The Most Gold Wins
discoverywest.us.description: S17 E01 Parker and Tony set 13,000-ounce gold totals, sparking a battle to see who can mine the most and reigniting an old feud; Rick faces health issues and an uncertain future; a new player enters the Klondike fray.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush : A Midas Mess
discoverywest.us.description: S17 E02 Tony's crew sinks a bulldozer and two trucks in the Midas Cut while his grandson flirts with a rock truck driver; Parker pushes to get his second wash plant running; Buzz struggles to assemble a new plant.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush : Diagnosing Rick ᴺᵉʷ
discoverywest.us.description: S17 E03 Rick receives a life-altering diagnosis; Greenhorns push Tony to his breaking point; Parker fires up a third plant and gets surprising gold results.

discoverywest.us.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers ᴺᵉʷ
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E02 The Tunnel of Chaos The I-70 Eisenhower Tunnel closes in both directions as a 78-vehicle pileup creates mass chaos; mountain recovery and stauffer's towing battle high winds and slick roads to clear wreckage and keep major highways moving.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
discoverywest.us.description: S06 E02 Last Stand in Silver City Hoping to right the mining mistakes of his father, a rookie Idaho miner closes his failing 30-year-old auto business to chase gold in the remote Idaho Hills.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E09 For Love of Nuggets The guys travel to British Columbia to save a recluse miner living off grid; with snow approaching, Freddy must persuade him to abandon his dreams of landing only monster-nuggets and to also focus on catching fine gold.

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures: House Calls
discoverywest.us.description: S03 E01 Sinister Sin City Zak joins the team for an urgent house call in Las Vegas when a man claims his ex-wife has been possessed by a demon; their daughter is caught in the spiritual crossfire; can the guys break the entity's grip on the family before it's too late?

discoverywest.us.title: Auction Kings
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E08 Pink Cadillac; Baseball Memorabilia A rockabilly musician's pink Cadillac; a small tugboat; historic baseball memorabilia.

discoverywest.us.title: Live to Farm ᴺᵉʷ
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E03 You Go Girl The family visits some East Coast friends: The New York Farm Girls. Farming isn't easy when the cows don't want to cooperate. The dairy farm crowns a new winner for Fastest Milker and Farmer Grayce shows us how millennials get it done.

discoverywest.us.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E03 Sex, Lies and Surveillance Tape A hotel guest reports a theft that launches an investigation with security and Metro detectives, but the truth proves to be far more scandalous.

discoverywest.us.title: Major League Fishing : 2026 Heavy Hitters Qualifying: B2 Orange Lake
discoverywest.us.description: Heavy Hitters Qualifying Group B Day Two from Marion County, FL. Anglers compete to advance as well as for the $10,000 Big Bass Bonus.

discoverywest.us.title: Moonshiners
discoverywest.us.description: S16 E03 Mine and Shine Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E08 Tomato, Tomate Officers discover a lethal load in the back seat of a car; 70-year-old sisters are caught trying to smuggle pain pills; a woman and son with fake visas attempt to cross into the US; officers assist a surgeon whose vehicle will only drive in reverse.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E10 Don't Get Cocky Two men are caught attempting to smuggle a rooster for cockfighting; officers find millions of dollars of counterfeit goods; a woman flees after dumping drugs on the bridge; an illicit load is found hidden in the axles of a lowboy trailer.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E04 The Kids Aren't Alright Officers find a concealed load in the side panels of a truck; Hundreds of gun parts headed for Mexico are intercepted; A man who claims to have been kidnapped by a drug cartel seeks asylum in the US; A traveler arrives with an unusual cut of meat.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E12 Florida or Bust A concealed shipment is hidden in the fifth wheel of a tractor-trailer; officers searching a courier's van find a lethal cache; an unlikely source sets off the radiation detector; a young woman is detained for a warrant she didn't know she had.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E09 Magazines in Socks Officers make a massive seizure after searching a spicy load; a former teacher is surprised to find she has an arrest warrant; two men are caught with gun parts in their luggage; a traveler's cargo is scrutinized when crossing liquor into the U.S.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: No Gun Intended Drug cartels are estimated to control up to one-third of Mexico's territory — there's an insatiable demand for guns and ammo south of the border, and a ready supply of Americans willing to smuggle them. CBP is ready to intercept.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Files
discoverywest.us.description: S03 E08 History Got It Wrong Was the Hindenburg truly destroyed by accident or by sabotage?; could the famous Patterson-Gimlin Bigfoot footage hold clues that only modern analysis can define?; what really happened when 50,000 Persian soldiers disappeared in 524 B.C.?

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Files
discoverywest.us.description: S03 E04 Lost Treasures What really became of Königsberg Castle's Amber Room, stolen by the Nazis? Could a lost hard drive in a British landfill hold millions in Bitcoin? Did King Solomon's legendary mines ever exist?

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Files
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E08 Who Done It? Josh uncovers the culprits behind three of history's most baffling mysteries -- the suspected murder of explorer Meriwether Lewis, a possible U.N. plot around Dag Hammarskjöld's 1961 plane crash and the vanishing of New York judge Joseph Crater.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Files
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E11 The Supernatural Josh Gates explores the supernatural, from Nikola Tesla's mysterious Death Ray to an encoded message from a Sicilian nun believed to be of demonic origin; scientists uncover the real explanation behind the Oracle of Delphi's prophetic visions.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition X

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition X
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E05 Werewolves of France Heather and Phil travel to the French countryside to track down werewolves that have terrorized the locals for centuries; as their investigation deepens, they must figure out if this beast is supernatural or an elusive wolf undiscovered by man.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition X
discoverywest.us.description: S12 E04 Ghosts of Guam Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores; after reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition X
discoverywest.us.description: S11 E03 Blackbeard's Ghost Heather and Phil explore Ocracoke Island, where locals fear the ghost of Blackbeard is lingering; is the pirate's restless spirit protecting hidden treasure, or seeking vengeance upon the living?

fxm.us.title: Lincoln
fxm.us.description: With the nation embroiled in still another year with the high death count of Civil War, President Abraham Lincoln brings the full measure of his passion, humanity and political skill to what would become his defining legacy: to end the war and permanently abolish slavery through the 13th Amendment. Having great courage, acumen and moral fortitude, Lincoln pushes forward to compel the nation, and those in government who oppose him, to aim toward a greater good for all mankind. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2012

fxm.us.title: The Ox-Bow Incident
fxm.us.description: In this classic Western, wanderers Gil Carter (Henry Fonda) and Art Croft (Henry Morgan) ride into a small Nevada town plagued by cattle thieves. Initially suspected of being the rustlers themselves, Carter and Croft eventually join a posse out to get the criminals, who also may be involved in a recent shooting. When the posse closes in on a group that could be the fugitives, they must decide on a course of action, with numerous lives hanging in the balance. (Western) - 1943

fxm.us.title: Hombre
fxm.us.description: John Russell finds that the world is not so welcoming when he returns to his Arizona hometown to collect his inheritance. A white man raised by American Indians, Russell is subjected to numerous instances of racism when people discover his background. When the stagecoach Russell is riding in is held up by a gang run by one of the scheming passengers, Cicero Grimes, it falls to Russell to defend the passengers -- the very people who have dismissed and insulted him. (Western) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Bandolero!
fxm.us.description: There is little hope for bandit Dee Bishop (Dean Martin) and his gang as they wait to be hanged. But at the last second, the hangman -- Dee's brother, Mace (James Stewart), in disguise -- helps them escape. After kidnapping a rancher's wife (Raquel Welch) and with the vengeful sheriff (George Kennedy) in pursuit, they retreat to an abandoned town. Tired of their desperado life, the brothers consider going straight. But when a gang of bandoleros attacks, their chances at starting over seem dim. (Western, Drama) - 1968

fxm.us.title: 100 Rifles
fxm.us.description: When half-breed Indian Yaqui Joe (Burt Reynolds) robs an Arizona bank, he is pursued by dogged lawman Lyedecker (Jim Brown). Fleeing to Mexico, Joe is imprisoned by General Verdugo (Fernando Lamas), who is waging a war against the Yaqui Indians. When Lyedecker attempts to intervene, he is thrown into prison as well. Working together, the two escape and take refuge in the hills, where Lyedecker meets beautiful Yaqui freedom fighter Sarita (Raquel Welch) and begins to question his allegiances. (Western) - 1969

fxm.us.title: Moulin Rouge
fxm.us.description: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman). (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 2001

fxm.us.title: Arachnophobia
fxm.us.description: After a nature photographer (Mark L. Taylor) dies on assignment in Venezuela, a poisonous spider hitches a ride in his coffin to his hometown in rural California, where arachnophobe Dr. Ross Jennings (Jeff Daniels) has just moved in with his wife, Molly (Harley Jane Kozak), and young son. As town residents start turning up dead, Jennings begins to suspect spiders, and must face his fears as he and no-nonsense exterminator Delbert McClintock (John Goodman) fight to stop a deadly infestation. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1990

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters
fxm.us.description: After the members of a team of scientists (Harold Ramis, Dan Aykroyd, Bill Murray) lose their cushy positions at a university in New York City, they decide to become "ghostbusters" to wage a high-tech battle with the supernatural for money. They stumble upon a gateway to another dimension, a doorway that will release evil upon the city. The Ghostbusters must now save New York from complete destruction. fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters II
fxm.us.description: After saving New York City from a ghost attack, the Ghostbusters -- a team of spirit exterminators -- is disbanded for demolishing parts of the city during the battle. But when Ghostbuster Peter Venkman learns that spirits have taken an interest in his son, the men launch a rogue ghost-chasing mission. The quest quickly goes awry, landing them in court. fxm.us.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Super Password
buzzr.us.description: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword. (Game show) - 1984-09-24

foodnetworkwest.us.description: In Los Angeles, a late-night spot serves breakfast with a twist, like drunken French toast; in Columbus, Ohio, a funky joint serves creative combos like brisket on corn cakes; in Phoenix, a barbecue stop smokes up prime rib and pork belly dumplings.

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Seafood and Savory

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Tasty Traditions
foodnetworkwest.us.description: In Seattle, a funky spot makes their name with scratch-made Russian piroshki; a joint in Kona serves up a bite of culture with their authentic Hawaiian cuisine; in Chicago, an old-school Jewish deli dishes out their specialties cafeteria-style.

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sandwich Showcase

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Coming Together in Cali

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Eating Alaska
foodnetworkwest.us.description: Guy Fieri and his son, Hunter, are taking a culinary journey up to Juneau, Alaska, and they dive into everything from a family-run, wood-fired pizza wagon making reindeer pie to a funky basement spot mashing up Latin-Asian fusion.

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Family Meals
foodnetworkwest.us.description: Two brothers-in-law carry on a decades-long seafood tradition; a mother-son duo running a breakfast, lunch and dinner joint in honor of their Pop; father-son meat masters firing up killer char-becue.

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Lots of Latin
foodnetworkwest.us.description: Guy Fieri is loading up on all kinds of Latin on this trip; in Logan, Utah, a Salvadoran spot puttin' out pupusas and a cabeza creation.

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Authentic to Inventive
foodnetworkwest.us.description: Dishes from real deal to really creative; in Portland, Ore., a 70-year-old icon is serving up authentic Chinese recipes from the chef's hometown; a restaurant in Oklahoma City is cooking chicken and biscuits.

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Meat and Heat

foodnetworkwest.us.description: Guy Fieri's diving into Thai food, pie and hearty fries; in San Diego, a spot is serving fish and ribs; in Arroyo Seco, N.M., a New Zealand food truck makes meat pies; a cozy joint loads up bison chili fries.

foodnetworkwest.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - Treats for Todd

fxwest.us.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
fxwest.us.description: The adventure continues in this "Star Wars" sequel. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), Han Solo (Harrison Ford), Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) and Chewbacca (Peter Mayhew) face attack by the Imperial forces and its AT-AT walkers on the ice planet Hoth. While Han and Leia escape in the Millennium Falcon, Luke travels to Dagobah in search of Yoda. Only with the Jedi master's help will Luke survive when the dark side of the Force beckons him into the ultimate duel with Darth Vader (David Prowse). (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1980

fxwest.us.title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
fxwest.us.description: Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) battles horrible Jabba the Hutt and cruel Darth Vader to save his comrades in the Rebel Alliance and triumph over the Galactic Empire. Han Solo (Harrison Ford) and Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) reaffirm their love and team with Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian (Billy Dee Williams), the Ewoks and the androids C-3PO and R2-D2 to aid in the disruption of the Dark Side and the defeat of the evil emperor. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1983

fxwest.us.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
fxwest.us.description: Capt. Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp) arrives at Port Royal in the Caribbean without a ship or crew. His timing is inopportune, however, because later that evening the town is besieged by a pirate ship. The pirates kidnap the governor's daughter, Elizabeth (Keira Knightley), who's in possession of a valuable coin that is linked to a curse that has transformed the pirates into the undead. A gallant blacksmith (Orlando Bloom) in love with Elizabeth allies with Sparrow in pursuit of the pirates. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2003

fxwest.us.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
fxwest.us.description: When ghostly pirate Davy Jones comes to collect a blood debt, Capt. Jack Sparrow must find a way to avoid his fate lest his soul be damned for all time. Nevertheless, the wily ghost manages to interrupt the wedding plans of Jack's friends Will Turner and Elizabeth Swann. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2006

fxwest.us.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
fxwest.us.description: Will Turner (Orlando Bloom) and Elizabeth Swann (Keira Knightley) join forces with Capt. Barbossa (Geoffrey Rush) to free Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp) from Davy Jones' locker. Meanwhile, the crew of the Flying Dutchman ghost ship wreaks havoc on the Seven Seas. The friends must navigate dangerous waters to confront Chinese pirate Sao Feng (Chow Yun-Fat) and, ultimately, they must choose sides in a battle wherein the pirate life hangs in the balance. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2007

fxwest.us.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
fxwest.us.description: Thrust into an all-new adventure, a down-on-his-luck Capt. Jack Sparrow feels the winds of ill-fortune blowing even more strongly when deadly ghost sailors led by his old nemesis, the evil Capt. Salazar, escape from the Devil's Triangle. Jack's only hope of survival lies in seeking out the legendary Trident of Poseidon, but to find it, he must forge an uneasy alliance with a brilliant and beautiful astronomer and a headstrong young man in the British navy. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2017

fxwest.us.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
fxwest.us.description: The checkered past of Capt. Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp) catches up to him when he encounters Angelica (Penélope Cruz), a beautiful pirate that Jack once loved then left. Angelica forces him to accompany her to the Queen Anne's Revenge, the ship of the notorious Blackbeard (Ian McShane). Accompanied by a zombie crew, the trio sets sail to find the legendary Fountain of Youth. However, Jack's rival, Barbossa (Geoffrey Rush), also seeks the fountain, as does a ship from Spain. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2011

fxwest.us.title: The Unholy
fxwest.us.description: A girl inexplicably gains the power to heal the sick after a supposed visitation from the Virgin Mary. lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - Break Out the Campaign
lafftv.us.description: Vanessa turns to Mike and Carol for advice on her State Assembly campaign; Kyle is overcome with anxiety when Ed gifts him an expensive watch. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - Baked Sale
lafftv.us.description: Mike's offer to help Jen with her school's bake sale goes up in smoke; Kyle finds unlikely advice from Joe on where he should enroll in college. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - I'm With Cupid
lafftv.us.description: Mike plays cupid for Joe when he sets him up on a date with Cece; Kyle is jealous when Ryan invites Jen to be a guest on their podcast. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - Student Doubt
lafftv.us.description: When Mandy worries about Kyle passing his first college exam, she secretly enlists Vanessa, Jen and Ryan to help tutor him; Mike learns of Ed and Chuck's superstition involving their decision-making. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: The Middle - The Carpool
lafftv.us.description: Principal Barker (Rachel Dratch) asks the parents to form carpools while the bus drivers are on strike; Axl becomes an astronomy expert so he can tutor an attractive student; Mike receives two tickets to a basketball game. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: The Middle - Hungry Games
lafftv.us.description: Reverend Deveaux interferes with the Hecks' plan to use their coupon for an all-you-can-eat buffet after church. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: The Middle - The Award
lafftv.us.description: Frankie tries to persuade Mike to attend a dinner honoring his dedicated service at the quarry; Sue forms a plan to build connections between students; Axl hopes to track down a girl who left a message on his phone. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: The Middle - Vacation Days
lafftv.us.description: Brick makes it hard for Mike to relax during the vacation he was forced to take; Frankie is furious when she learns that Axl was in town without letting her know; Sue tries extra hard to please her customers after receiving a bad review. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Home Improvement - Al's Fair Lady
lafftv.us.description: Tim (Tim Allen) doesn't understand why Al (Richard Karn) has trouble accepting extravagant gifts from his new girlfriend. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Home Improvement - Bewitched
lafftv.us.description: Tim (Tim Allen) becomes a murder suspect after Wilson (Earl Hindman) disappears following a Halloween party. With Patricia Richardson. (Sitcom, Hallowe'en)

lafftv.us.title: Home Improvement - Not-So-Great-Scott
lafftv.us.description: Tim (Tim Allen) accidentally tells Heidi (Debbe Dunning) that her husband is seeing one of Jill's (Patricia Richardson) patients. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Home Improvement - Tim's First Car
lafftv.us.description: When Tim's (Tim Allen) first car is junked, Jill (Patricia Richardson) decides to find him an exact replica. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - The Marriage Doctor
lafftv.us.description: Kyle shares his fears with Mike about meeting the church's new minister; Ryan helps Eve with her debate assignment. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - The Shortcut
lafftv.us.description: Ed plans a surprise dinner for Mike's 25 years at The Outdoor Man; Mandy wants her and Kyle to move in with her parents to save money after they're married. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - Papa Bear
lafftv.us.description: A bear wanders into the store when Kyle leaves the loading dock door open. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - Gameday Forecast: Showers
lafftv.us.description: Mike learns that Mandy and Kyle's wedding shower is on the same day as the big Broncos-Chargers game; Ryan offers to host the men's party at his place; Ed insists that abiding by his superstitious rituals is the only way the Broncos will win. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: The Middle - The College Tour
lafftv.us.description: Mike takes Sue on a college tour weekend; Frankie abandons Brick and his school project to go see Axl in his first college football game. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: The Middle - The Christmas Wall
lafftv.us.description: Tired of the thankless job of decorating for the holidays, Frankie decides to have a minimalist Christmas; Axl and Sean argue; Brick tries to write a Christmas letter. (Sitcom, Christmas)

lafftv.us.title: The Middle - Pam Freakin' Staggs
lafftv.us.description: Frankie starts hanging out with a woman who was one of the popular girls when they went to high school together; Mike learns Brick received the Athlete of the Month award; Axl tries to get Devin Levin to go out with him. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: The Middle - A Quarry Story
lafftv.us.description: When Frankie finds an old, uncashed paycheck from Ehlert Motors, Mr. Ehlert forces her to work for a day to collect her money. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: That '70s Show - Oh Baby (We Got a Good Thing Goin')

lafftv.us.title: That '70s Show - Who's Been Sleeping Here
lafftv.us.description: Kelso's choice for his daughter's godparents causes tension in the group; a surprise thief keeps breaking into the record shop. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: That '70s Show - Gimme Shelter
lafftv.us.description: Eric decides to try being a chiropractor but comes to his senses when he nearly cripples Donna. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: That '70s Show - 2120 So. Michigan Avenue
lafftv.us.description: In order for Eric to graduate he must take a P.E. class, but when he learns that Casey Kelso is the gym coach, his nerves get the best of him. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: That '70s Show - 2000 Light Years From Home
lafftv.us.description: Eric learns that his parents have spent all of his college savings, so he must find a way to finance the next four years. (Sitcom)

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S12 E09 Tri-State Scratch King David helps a single dad find a move-in ready home he can enjoy with his 5-year-old son.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S19 E13 Single Mom Defies the Odds Despite limited finances, a single mom has made a loving, thriving home for her three children; and now after a million-dollar lottery win, she's calling on David Bromstad to help her.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S11 E01 Mortgage Free in Atlanta After winning $1 million, a San Francisco family decides it wants to live mortgage-free and buy a huge home in Atlanta; they're looking for a place with a few projects and a big yard; David shows them just how far their money can go in the suburbs.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S19 E07 BFF Lottery David brings along his bestie to help another pair of besties find a dream home for a daughter in Rochester, N.Y.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S12 E11 Bangor Bucks A mother wins big on a scratcher, but since she already has her dream home, she has decided to help her daughter find hers; the duo enlists David to get her growing family out of a cramped apartment and into a house with more space in Bangor, Maine.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S19 E02 Santa Fe Family Home With the help of an inheritance, a couple and their daughter search for a house upgrade to fit their extended family; David's tasked with finding a place big enough for a teenager, an adult son, and some pets in Santa Fe, New Mexico.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S12 E05 Second Chance Lottery After a close call with a motorcycle accident, a New York couple credits "My Lottery Dream Home" marathons as their motivation to get through rehabilitation; David is happy to help them find their own dream home in sunny St. Augustine, Fla.

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E02 Horror in the Ominous Ozarks Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Ominous Ozarks where three homes duke it out for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a home of devilish doppelgängers and a ghostly gangster meeting place.

hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E03 The Eeriest of the East Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Eerie East where four homes vie for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a ghoulish home overrun with ghosts and a Victorian infested with spiders and apparitions.

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E04 Scares of the Mysterious Midwest Retta's journey takes her to the Mysterious Midwest where four homes contend for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it includes a ghostly home with a history of squatters and a Victorian full of ghosts and dolls.

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E05 Nightmares in New England Retta's journey to find scary takes her to Nightmarish New England where four homes battle for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a large house with whistling and humming specters and a diabolical duplex.

hgtvwest.us.title: My House Has a Secret
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E01 The Caves Beneath and Buried in the Past A homeowner explores a massive, unexplored cavern system hidden below her closet in Virginia. And in Pennsylvania, a couple opens boarded-up fireplaces in their fixer-upper and discover old spaces that may hold treasure.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S273 E05 Mountain Man vs. City Girl A couple has differing ideas as they look to buy their first house together in Knoxville, Tennessee. She wants the contemporary new-build she's always dreamed of, but he has his heart set on an older home in need of serious TLC.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S273 E10 Some Like It Cheap A couple needs to find a bigger home for themselves and their two children in Dallas; she's ready to spend on a move-in-ready place close to town, but he prefers to spend less on something farther out where he can live out his reno dreams.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S272 E01 Buy First Think Later Fresh off a divorce, a free-spirited buyer searches for a home of her own in Toledo, Ohio; she can be impulsive and doesn't mind spending, but her close friend is along on the search and hopes to keep her grounded and under budget.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S273 E04 Bestie Brawl A buyer uses his best friend as his agent to find his first home in Indianapolis; he wants a place near work with plenty of outdoor space for entertaining, but she thinks his big renovation dreams are out of line with both his budget and reality.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E09 Vintage in Chicagoland A young couple searches for a vintage home that's near a town center in the Chicago suburbs; he works from home and wants a turnkey Tudor, but with her job as an interior designer, she sees renovation at every turn.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E25 Philly Charm vs. the Burbs A couple's searching for a bigger home for their blended family in Philadelphia. She wants a historic Craftsman with tons of charm, but he prefers something more contemporary in the suburbs.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E43 Palm Fiction A writer and director in Los Angeles looks to live his best life with a new place in Palm Springs, California; he wants a large turnkey home at a low price, but his friend and agent both think that's a dream that may be pure La La Land.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: Different Dreams in DC Transplants in Washington, D.C., look to put down roots in their new city; one prefers a row home to fix up with his family's help; the other doesn't want any projects and thinks a modern condo is a better choice.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: Pressure Is on in Raleigh A couple is ready to buy their first home in Raleigh, N.C.; she's fine with a fixer and hoping for a place with lots of character; he's more focused on the home's functionality and prefers a new build.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S263 E11 Two Story vs. Single Story in New Jersey A couple searches for their first home, but can't agree on what to buy; she wants a single-story fixer at a low cost, but he's pushing for a two-story that's move-in ready, and he's willing to spend big to get it.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E13 Gaga for Gilmore Girls A mother and daughter butt heads searching for an Atlanta dream home just like the one on their favorite show Gilmore Girls; mom wants a cozy Stars Hollow vibe they can bond over, but her daughter has more privacy in mind.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S279 E05 Frenemy Houses A couple's at odds on what's more important in a home as they relocate their family from Philadelphia to Texas; he wants a place that's epic with a pool and a saloon, but she's after something more practical and safe for their four children.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S278 E08 Full House Beats A Pair With his new job starting soon, a couple has just one weekend to find a home in Kansas City, Missouri. They need a place that will accommodate them, her college-age twins and his mom, but their biggest challenge may be his indecision.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S273 E08 Gotta Have Faith Three church friends look to buy a home together in Tacoma, Wash.; they're leaning on their faith to find the right home, but with three different sets of opinions and priorities, getting everyone to agree may be a challenge.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S269 E07 Bestie Buyers Put to the Test Best friends look to purchase a vacation home together in South Haven, Mich.; the dream is put to the test, however, as one wants to stretch their limits to be by the lake, the other is afraid they'll blow their budget.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: S280 E02 Multi-Gen Mess A young family searches for a historic home in Saint Paul, Minnesota. They're looking for a place that can also accommodate his mom, but his wife and mother are at odds over nearly everything, and he finds himself just trying to keep the peace.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S269 E12 Act Your Age A single 25-year-old lawyer looks to settle down and find a suburban fixer in Austin, Texas; he wants an older place with charm; his opinionated mom thinks he should find something turnkey near the downtown nightlife.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E50 Tudor Troubles in New York After five years in Palm Springs, a couple looks to move back to the New York City suburbs to be closer to family; he wants to remodel a moderately priced midcentury, but the other insists on going all out on a traditional Tudor.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E49 Catering to Needs in Atlanta A caterer is ready to become a homeowner again in Atlanta; he's looking for a modern home with the space and kitchen to expand his business, and his close friend is along to keep him focused and mindful of his finances.

retroplex.us.description: A singing shopkeeper (Judy Canova) turns deputy to help her sheriff boyfriend (John Russell) clean up the town. - 1952

retroplex.us.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
retroplex.us.description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang. - 1967

retroplex.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
retroplex.us.description: Flamboyant inventor Preston Tucker's ill-fated battle to produce a faster and safer automobile for postwar America. - 1988

retroplex.us.title: Live!

retroplex.us.title: The Silencer

retroplex.us.title: Exit the Dragon, Enter the Tiger
retroplex.us.description: A fighter (Bruce Li) finds drug smugglers behind the death of Bruce Lee. (Action, Martial arts) - 1976

retroplex.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
retroplex.us.description: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court. (Biography, Historical drama) - 1988

retroplex.us.title: In Old Caliente
retroplex.us.description: In California, Roy (Roy Rogers) works on the large ranch of Don Jose (Frank Puglia), one of the last of the major Spanish landowners. The foreman of the ranch, Saguaro (Jack LaRue), is involved with a gang of bandits and hopes to pit the newly arriving Americans against the dwindling Spanish and native populations. Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name. (Western) - 1939

retroplex.us.title: Outlaws of the Plains
retroplex.us.description: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Carson City Kid
retroplex.us.description: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: Romance of the West
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
retroplex.us.description: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: The Dawn Rider
retroplex.us.description: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
retroplex.us.description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing. (Western) - 1941

retroplex.us.title: The Desert Trail
retroplex.us.description: John Scott (John Wayne) is a rodeo rider, assisted by his buddy Kansas Charlie (Eddy Chandler). But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
retroplex.us.description: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: The Man From Utah
retroplex.us.description: One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: The Silencer
retroplex.us.description: An FBI agent (Brennan Elliott) must fake his own death to team with an assassin (Michael Dudikoff) and infiltrate a terrorist group. (Action) - 1999

retroplex.us.title: Live!
retroplex.us.description: Documentarian Rex (David Krumholtz) follows ruthless reality television producer Katy Courbet (Eva Mendes), a woman who will stop at nothing to revive the American Broadcasting Network's failing ratings -- and forward her own career. To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize. (Comedy drama) - 2007

retroplex.us.title: McLintock!
retroplex.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. (Western, Comedy) - 1963

retroplex.us.title: The Proud Rebel
retroplex.us.description: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland). (Western) - 1958

Although the outlaw Bill Judd (Jack Ingram) seems to be behind the deaths, the sheriff is not taking any action. When Cheyenne learns the sheriff may be taking orders from another party, he and Fuzzy try to find out who is controlling the criminal element. (Western) - 1947

For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy. (Western) - 1948

When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad). tlcwest.us.title: OutDaughtered
tlcwest.us.description: How many people does it take to prepare 40 baby bottles a day, change 420 diapers a week, and administer feedings every three hours? Two, as in Danielle and Adam Busby. In April 2015, the Texas couple became parents to the first-ever all-female quintuplets born in the U.S. The new additions -- Ava, Olivia, Hazel, Riley and Parker -- join 4-year-old Blayke, turning a family of three into a bustling household of eight overnight. "Outdaughtered" profiles the Busbys' journey, focusing on the babies' delivery and the massive adjustment period that follows. tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Essence of Grill Culture
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
tastemade.us.description: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemade.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemade.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemade.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemade.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Cauliflower Star Power
tastemade.us.description: Cauliflower can be transformed into unexpected, delicious and nutritious dishes; Frankie discusses why to buy dried-goods in bulk and makes a big chuck roast that stretches over three dishes.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Too Hot To Cook
tastemade.us.description: When the temps are soaring and turning on your stove or oven is not even an option, Frankie's no cook meals will blow you away. Enjoy refreshing, nourishing dishes that will help keep you cool all summer long.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Plant-Based Budget Meals
tastemade.us.description: Frankie busts the myth that eating plant-based is expensive. Preparing these good-for-you meals is all about eating seasonally to save money on produce, and shopping the bulk aisle for even more savings on plant-based pantry items.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Picnic Lunches
tastemade.us.description: It's field trip day, and Frankie shows off his best handheld lunches perfect for leisurely days at the park, the beach or the pool. These sturdy meals are made to travel and only get better with time.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Winter Is Here
tastemade.us.description: The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Crunchy
tastemade.us.description: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Warm + Cozy Winter
tastemade.us.description: Frankie gets cozy in the kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter; from a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal. (Cooking) - 2021-02-05

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Bananas For Bananas
tastemade.us.description: As one of the cheapest members of the produce aisle, bananas will save you bunches of money when you whip up these delightfully appealing recipes that go above and beyond basic bread. (Cooking) - 2022-03-18

allblkgems.us.title: A House Divided - New Beginnings

cinevault.us.title: The Shadow Riders
cinevault.us.description: Mac Traven (Tom Selleck) is a Civil War veteran who fought for the North, while his brother, Dal (Sam Elliott), was allied with the South. In spite of this considerable point of contention, the siblings must work together when they find that other family members have been abducted, along with Dal's girlfriend, Kate (Katharine Ross). Joined by their trouble-making uncle "Black Jack" (Ben Johnson), Mac and Dal relentlessly pursue the criminals to rescue their relatives. (Movie, Western) - 1982-09-28

cinevault.us.title: Murphy's Romance
cinevault.us.description: Emma (Sally Field), a divorced single mother seeking to start her life over, moves to a small town in Arizona. She builds a relationship with Murphy (James Garner), the older local pharmacist but, due to his age, it remains platonic. Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 1985

cinevault.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
cinevault.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Comedy, Crime drama, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2008-04-30

cinevault.us.title: Did You Hear About the Morgans?
cinevault.us.description: New Yorkers Paul (Hugh Grant) and Meryl (Sarah Jessica Parker) Morgan seem to have it all -- except that their marriage is crumbling around them. But their romantic woes are small compared to the trouble they find themselves in after witnessing a murder. To protect them from an assassin, federal agents whisk away Paul and Meryl to a small town in Wyoming, where their marriage will crash and burn, or their passion will reignite. (Comedy, Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2009-12-18

cinevault.us.title: Bewitched
cinevault.us.description: Movie star Jack Wyatt (Will Ferrell) has hit a rough patch in his career. Looking to make a comeback, he signs on to play the role of Darrin in a movie version of the popular 1960s sitcom "Bewitched." Jack insists that an unknown is hired to play Darrin's better half, the beguiling witch-housewife Samantha, so the studio finds an up-and-comer named Isabel Bigelow (Nicole Kidman). Once shooting begins, though, Jack learns that Isabel was cast too well -- since she actually is a witch. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2005-06-24

cinevault.us.title: The Stepfather
cinevault.us.description: When Michael Harding (Penn Badgley) returns home from military school, he discovers that his mother (Sela Ward) has a new man, named David (Dylan Walsh), in her life. Though David makes Michael's mother very happy, Michael cannot seem to shake feelings of distrust. He becomes increasingly suspicious of the man and wonders if the pleasant exterior hides a sinister side. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2009-10-16

cinevault.us.title: Darkness Falls
cinevault.us.description: In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-01-24

cinevault.us.title: Red Water
cinevault.us.description: Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water. (Movie, Thriller) - 2003-08-17

bravovault.us.description: S06 E05 Sex, Lies and Audiotape A devastating audio recording surfaces at Brittany's housewarming party; Lisa and Katie take Schwartz to task after his latest drunken blackout; Ariana reveals the heartbreaking reason for her body image struggles.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E06 See You Next Tuesday Ariana's role in releasing Jax's scandalous audio recording leads to a fight with Sandoval; Scheana and Katie declare a truce; at SUR, James hustles to make sure his first DJ event is a success; Lala bonds with Billie, the new hostess.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E07 It's Not About the Pasta Scheana spirals out of control when she suspects Rob is pulling away; Stassi assists in dressing the staff for SUR's annual Gay Pride celebration; James erupts after Lala insults his girlfriend; Jax turns to an unlikely form of therapy.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E08 Best Mates Kristen tests Jax's patience when she flies out Brittany's mother for a visit; Lala schemes to repair Scheana and Katie's friendship; Lisa rewards Peter for years of loyal service; a salacious rumor about James and his best friend makes the rounds.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E09 Call Me Jason Stassi helps organize a party to honor Lisa Vanderpump's new role at Beverly Hills Lifestyle magazine; Schwartz's triplet brothers come for a visit and a Tom Sandoval makeover; Katie becomes the victim of body-shaming comments.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E10 Screams and Queens Ariana shines as the belle of the ball, while an embarrassed Stassi runs off in tears; Schwartz and Sandoval celebrate the approval of TomTom's permits by writing hefty checks; Sandoval and Ariana work through their intimacy issues.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E11 It's All Happening Lisa channels all her energy into restoring SUR after the devastating fire; Stassi consults a tarot card reader about her future with Patrick; James makes a startling admission about his feelings for Lala; Jax feels left behind.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E12 Wishful Sinking Jax cheats death when an attempt to show off goes horribly wrong; Raquel questions whether James still harbors romantic feelings for Lala; Ariana gets upset when Sandoval does not invite her on a business trip; Stassi interviews Lisa for her podcast.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E13 Vegas! Baby? Lisa takes Sandoval and Schwartz on a business trip to Las Vegas to design their new bar, but the guys focus more on partying than professionalism; Brittany tells Katie and Ariana she needs to take a pregnancy test.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E14 Watch Your Back Jax shows his lack of maturity when confronted with a reminder of his infidelity; Scheana sets Brittany up with SUR's hottest new bartender; Ariana's brother asks out new SUR hostess Billie Lee; James has an emotional reunion with his father.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E15 Nothing Here for Me Jax blindsides Brittany with the news he is considering moving to Florida for a job; Sandoval and Schwartz impress Lisa by creating innovative cocktails for TomTom; Stassi and Lala take Jax to task for always putting his needs above Brittany's.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E16 Sur Going South The Mexico adventure continues as the group explores a natural water park and the nightlife in Playa del Carmen; James tries to remain in Jax's favor by exposing Scheana's role in hooking up Brittany with the hot new bartender's assistant.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E17 The Smoking Gun The Playa del Carmen party continues as James takes over the DJ booth at a Mexican club; Lisa adopts a new dog; Schwartz horrifies Katie with a drunken blackout; Stassi realizes her relationship is in trouble.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E18 Karma's a Bitch After returning to Los Angeles, Kristen must tell her boyfriend about the night she spent with James; Sandoval convinces Lisa to throw a "progress party" to show off the TomTom space; Jax confronts Brittany's admirer.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E19 Reiki Breaky Heart Ariana and Brittany seek relationship advice from Lisa; Stassi throws a party to relaunch Katie's beauty blog; Katie and Tom celebrate their first wedding anniversary; Jax and Brittany's relationship takes a surprising turn.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E20 Lost Cause After a painful breakup, Brittany bounces back with new swagger and her sights set on a new man; Ariana blows up at Sandoval for choosing to support Jax over spending time with her; Kristen tries to convince Carter of her loyalty.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E21 Welcome to TomTom Sandoval and Schwartz give their friends a sneak peek at TomTom; Lisa must decide Jax's future at SUR; James receives huge news about his DJ career; Stassi introduces Lisa to her boyfriend with catastrophically awkward results.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E22 Reunion Part 1 Host Andy Cohen uncovers the real stories behind the scenes; Lisa Vanderpump sets Sandoval and Schwartz straight on their roles at TomTom; Jax shares the heartbreaking details of his father's passing; Ariana opens up about her body issues.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E23 Reunion Part 2 Andy recaps Katie and Schwartz's rollercoaster first year of marriage, the group questions Jax's relationship with his Reiki healer; Lala reveals more about her mysterious boyfriend; Billie Lee joins and opens up about life as a transgender woman.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E24 Reunion Part 3 Andy explores Jax's epic meltdown at SUR and his decision to break up with Brittany; Lala and James examine the intermittent flirting and fighting in their relationship; Katie and Schwartz discuss the prospect of having children.

Each episode focuses on one notorious killer and features first-hand accounts of their behavior; such killers range from Fred and Rose West, Ed Gein, the Clown Killer, to the Milwaukee Cannibal. Accounts are also given by detectives who ran the cases, journalists who reported on them, relatives, experts on analysis, and sometimes even survivors. (Documentary, Crime) - 2017-05-25

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: : Murder of a B Movie Queen
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Wasp Woman In 1986, cult actress Susan Cabot is found dead in her Los Angeles home; suspicion immediately falls on her son, Timothy Roman, the only witness and immediate suspect; what begins as a shocking Hollywood murder soon opens into a darker story.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Wasp Woman: Murder of a B Movie Queen
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 The Suspect The investigation deepens and Timothy's story becomes more complex; Timothy's life was shaped not only by his mother's troubled past but by a chapter in American medical history, as a patient enrolled in a now-buried clinical experiment.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Wasp Woman: Murder of a B Movie Queen

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Gay director James Whale makes four classics that pave the way for all Hollywood horror movies after, but his career was dimmed by anti-gay sentiment; Alfred Hitchcock uses queer characters and queer coded stories to keep audiences in suspense.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Werewolves, cat people, body-snatchers and doppelgängers are uniquely queer metaphors; from the classic "The Wolf Man" to queer-authored "Cat People," the monsters of the 1940s express shame and seek to rid themselves of the secret self.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The dangerous queer woman has been terrorizing horror audiences since before the dawn of cinema; the lesbian vampire sucks the lifeblood from women and men alike in the gothic novella "Carmilla" and films like "Dracula's Daughter."

moviesphere.us.title: Molly's Game
moviesphere.us.description: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. (Biography, Drama, Movie) - 2017-09-08

moviesphere.us.title: Divergent
moviesphere.us.description: Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2014-03-21

moviesphere.us.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
moviesphere.us.description: Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2015-03-19

moviesphere.us.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
moviesphere.us.description: Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.
