speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - Two Juniors and El Laguna
speedvision.us.description: Dale Earnhardt Jr. and Ray build a half-car half-truck El Laguna and have Al Unser Jr. race it against a vintage racing champion on a road course at Charlotte Motor Speedway.

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - Vintage Racing Takes an Awesome Turn
speedvision.us.description: Ray and Awesome Bill Elliot team up in a Corvette against 33 former Indy racers and their pro-am partners at the Brickyard.

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - American Graffiti Roars Again
speedvision.us.description: Ray restores the car that started it all for him: the 1958 Chevy from the iconic George Lucas film "American Graffiti."

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - California Cool: Woodie Wagons
speedvision.us.description: West Coast drivers of the 1940 Ford modified the vehicle for hot rodding and cut the top off.

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - Moonshiners and the 1940 Ford
speedvision.us.description: Junior Johnson, Bill Elliott and others describe the impact of the 1940 Ford in America in the years following World War II.

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - Marty Robbins Resto
speedvision.us.description: Ray restores the No. 777 Plymouth Belvedere driven by legendary singer Marty Robbins, and returns the vehicle to the racetrack.

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - Hot Rods and Dragsters
speedvision.us.description: Drag racers Don Prudhomme and John Force; director Ron Howard; musician Mike Love; Tom Cobb's legendary roadster.

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - Chipper Jones' International Car Show
speedvision.us.description: A Hall of Famer's search for an exotic car that fits; a blind man's "touchy-feely" approach to seeing great cars.

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - Fuller's 2029 Futuristic Build
speedvision.us.description: Back to the future with a majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Fastest Man on 2-Wheels
speedvision.us.description: Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - Power Play: Pro Line's Search Beyond 3000HP
speedvision.us.description: A need for speed in a Sleepy Georgia town has engineers pushing the boundaries to exceed 3000 horsepower.

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - Turn of the Century Cars
speedvision.us.description: Early 20th century cars with wooden wheels that go 85 mph.

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - Hot Wheels Legend Tour & The Urban Outlaw
speedvision.us.description: Urban Outlaw and designer Magnus Walker weighs in on his beloved Porsche and the legend of Hot Wheels.

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - Proving Provenance: A One-Off Ferrari!
speedvision.us.description: Tracing the origins and solving the mystery of a controversial all-aluminum bodied 512 BBI Boxer Ferrari.

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - Twin Cities Turbo
speedvision.us.description: Caffeine and Octane goes turbo in the Twin Cities; Ferrari Drifter Federico Sceriffo finds a home in Atlanta.

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - Buried Treasures
speedvision.us.description: Time capsules from the 1970s; a Daytona race car is buried in a car hauler for nearly 40 years.

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - Indy Car Rescue
speedvision.us.description: Mechanic Chris Paulsen restores a Kurtis Kraft roadster that finished second in the Indianapolis 500 and was placed on the roof of an auto-glass building for half a century.

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - Smokey's Truck
speedvision.us.description: Innovative NASCAR mechanic Henry "Smokey" Yunick sells his famous truck to a Virginia family in the 1960s. (Reality, Auto) - 2014-02-25

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - The Vanderbilt Cup
speedvision.us.description: The automobile impacts life in large cities in the early 20th century and contributes to the transformation of Long Island. (Reality, Auto) - 2014-03-04

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - Ray's Roots & the Yellow 303
speedvision.us.description: New Jersey racer Fred Dmuchowski drives for fun on weekends and becomes a local legend. (Reality, Auto) - 2014-03-11

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - The Corvette
speedvision.us.description: Rick recalls how the Chevrolet Corvette inspired the beginning of his car empire; musician Brad Paisley makes an appearance. (Reality, Auto) - 2014-03-18

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - GM Concept Cars
speedvision.us.description: General Motors' Vice President of Global Design Ed Welburn discusses the concept cars that his company decided not to produce. (Reality, Auto) - 2015-03-10

speedvision.us.title: AmeriCarna - The First Mustang
speedvision.us.description: Ray celebrates the 50th anniversary of the Ford Mustang; three Mustang owners share their stories of the iconic vehicle. (Reality, Auto) - 2015-03-17

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - 470MPH With Custom King George Poteet
speedvision.us.description: Jaguar F-Type Project 7 crosses the Pond. (Auto) - 2020-10-11

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - Art & Oddities at Old Car City, USA
speedvision.us.description: Mustang Mayhem at the big show. (Auto) - 2020-11-17

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Unsung Hero in the Movie Ford v. Ferrari
speedvision.us.description: Red carpet receptions for a Koenigsegg Regera. (Auto) - 2020-11-24

speedvision.us.title: Caffeine & Octane - Hollywood's Cars Come to Life at Picture Car Productions

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - Getting Blitzed at London's Café de Paris
truehistory.us.description: An evening in March 1941, when the Café de Paris is destroyed in the Blitz; the history of the café; how its destruction reflects the horrors of wartime London; the resiliency of the citizens who keep calm and carry on under the threat of war.

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - On Carnaby Street during the Swinging '60s
truehistory.us.description: Carnaby Street emerges in the 17th century; a symbol of social change in the 1960s; its history; it becomes a magnet for trendsetters and youth culture in post-war London; why these changes are embraced by some and seen as a threat by others.

truehistory.us.title: In the Footsteps of Van Gogh - The World of Vincent Van Gogh
truehistory.us.description: Tying together several facts about Van Gogh's life.

truehistory.us.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - Napoleon III's Paris
truehistory.us.description: Napoleon III declares himself emperor of France in 1853; his aim is to modernize the economy of France, create a sophisticated rail-transport system and completely rebuild Paris; this means that, for most Parisians, life is utterly disrupted.

truehistory.us.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - Baudelaire and the Definition of Modernism
truehistory.us.description: A poet and art critic named Charles Baudelaire begins writing systematically about art in 1846; his basic idea is that art should be "of its own times"; he struggles to find artists who will embody his ideals.

truehistory.us.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - The Shock of the New
truehistory.us.description: Edouard Manet is among the best-educated and most authoritatively independent artists of the 19th century; he paints works that transcend Baudelaire; Manet's painting is as great as Baudelaire's poetry and greater than his art criticism.

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Three Peoples Collide
truehistory.us.description: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Native Americans
truehistory.us.description: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe - The Medieval City - A Feast for the Senses
truehistory.us.description: The sights and smells of the medieval city; exploring the rich details of markets, monasteries, churches and religious and civic events; life in the townhouses of the rich, the tenements of the poor; the activities of medieval societies.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe - Rothenburg - Jewel On the Romantic Road
truehistory.us.description: A well-preserved German medieval city; exploring the imposing mansions of the city's former elite, the grand fountains and the market square with its remarkable gothic town Hall; visiting St. Jakob's Church; walking the bastions of the city walls.

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - Native America: A Story of Survival
truehistory.us.description: The commonly held views of Native Americans and the realities of a tapestry of vibrant cultures; Cobb explains the pitfalls that occur when history does not provide this crucial viewpoint; the mistake of consigning Native Americans to the past.

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - The Columbian Exchange: New Worlds for All
truehistory.us.description: The misleading dichotomy of Old World and New World impacts perceptions of Native Americans; the Columbian Exchange is the crux behind the creation of new worlds for all; shaping everything from the fauna and flora to the cuisines of the world.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - How Washington DC Came to Be
truehistory.us.description: Uncovering the origins of the District of Columbia; how the location for the national government is chosen; the original design and vision for the city by artist and engineer Pierre Charles L'Enfant; the creation and history of the National Mall.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The White House and the Presidency
truehistory.us.description: Tracking the history and fortunes of the White House; visiting the White House, beginning with the Oval Office and Cabinet Room; visiting the parks adjoining the White House; the Jefferson and Franklin Delano Roosevelt memorials.

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Star-Spangled Banner - Inspiring the Anthem
truehistory.us.description: A tour of national treasures from the Smithsonian; the artifact that inspires the national anthem; the flag that flows over Fort McHenry when Francis Scott Key pens "The Star-Spangled Banner"; the battle for the fort and the history of the flag.

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Presidents and Generals - Images of Leadership
truehistory.us.description: How some of the country's greatest leaders have seen themselves and been seen by the nation; Washington's uniform, swords and portraits; notable photographs of Lincoln; the history of Eisenhower's distinctive army jacket and his presidential look.

truehistory.us.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Understanding Culture through Cooking
truehistory.us.description: What one can learn about different cultural groups through the lens of their cookbooks; looking at two chicken recipes 200 years and a continent apart; learning to cook dishes from a 1748 French cookbook and "The Can-Opener Cookbook" of 1953.

truehistory.us.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Ancient Rome: Cooking with Apicius
truehistory.us.description: Whether the recipes in "De re coquinaria" are bizarre and disgusting, or they reflect a time of elegance and luxury; exploring its sala cattabia, minutal of apricots and botellum; finding three delicious, and even somewhat familiar, dishes.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Bread Masters
tastemadetravel.us.description: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Piloncillo
tastemadetravel.us.description: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tacos and a Tostada
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
tastemadetravel.us.description: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
tastemadetravel.us.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love

classica.us.title: House of Dreams
classica.us.description: Ein fantasievolles Konzert führt mit barocker Musik auf eine magische, musikalische Reise. Das Ensemble des Tafelmusik Barock Orchester hat sich auf historische Performances spezialisiert. Ihre Musik trifft auf barocke Kunst.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C-Dur, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, um den 250. Geburtstag des Komponisten zu feiern, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwarz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 8. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in F-Dur Op. 93, welche in den Jahren 1812 und 1813 geschrieben wurde und im Jahr 1814 ihre Erstaufführung feierte.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in D-Dur, 'Titan'
classica.us.description: Das Maggio Musicale Fiorentino ist das älteste Opernfestival Italiens. Der Maestro Daniel Harding übernimmt das Dirigieren in einem wunderbaren Konzertprogramm mit der tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81 von Johannes Brahms.

classica.us.title: Neun Sinfonien verändern die Welt
classica.us.description: Der Filmemacher Michael Waldmann besuchte das West-Eastern Divan Orchestra während der Proben in Spanien und schloss sich den Touren nach Südkorea und China an.

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - 1. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Ein buntes Weihnachtskonzert der Philharmonie zuidnederland mit Tschaikowskis berühmtem Klavierkonzert Nr. 1. Chefdirigent Dmitri Liss bringt gemeinsam mit Meisterpianist Boris Berezovsky sein russisches Blut in Wallung.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 4 in B-Dur, op. 60
classica.us.description: "Les Dissonances" spielen die 4. Sinfonie von Ludwig van Beethoven an der Opéra Dijon.

classica.us.title: Werke für Laute von J. S. Bach
classica.us.description: Der französische Lautenist Thomas Dunford spielt in diesem intimen Kammermusikkonzert, das 2017 im Concertgebouw Brügge aufgezeichnet wurde, verschiedene Werke für Laute von J. S. Bach. Auf dem Programm steht Suite für Laute in g-Moll.

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
classica.us.description: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo.

classica.us.title: Donizetti - L'elisir d'amore
classica.us.description: Riccardo Frizza dirigiert das Orchester Gli Originali und den Coro Donizetti Opera. Diese Inszenierung von Frederic Wake-Walker aus dem Jahr 2021 ist einzigartig, da sie die vollständige, von Alberto Zedda rekonstruierte originale Partitur enthält.

classica.us.title: Mozart - 23. Klavierkonzerte, KV 488
classica.us.description: Francesco Attesti gilt als einer der besten Interpreten des romantischen Repertoires. Zusammen mit dem Dirigenten Paolo Belloli und dem OIDA-Orchester spielt er die Klavierkonzerte Nr. 14 und 23, KV 449 und KV 488 von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-12-03

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: IVC 2021 - Finale: Schumann, Sibelius u. a
classica.us.description: Der Bariton Arvid Fagerfjäll und der Pianist Hikaru Kanki führen "Lust der Sturmnacht" aus Robert Schumanns Kerner-Liedern, Op. 35 auf. Diese Aufführung wurde in der Verkadefabriek in 's-Hertogenbosch, Niederlande, aufgezeichnet. (Music, Classical) - 2023-09-05

classica.us.title: Brahms - Tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81
classica.us.description: Maestro Daniel Harding dirigiert das Orchester des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem Konzertprogramm mit der tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81 von Brahms und der Sinfonie Nr. 1 in D-Dur, 'Titan' von Mahler. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-06-13

classica.us.title: J. S. Bach - Messe in H-Moll (BWV 232)
classica.us.description: Thomaskantor Georg Christoph Biller stand am Dirigentenpult, als das renommierte Freiburger Barockorchester und der Leipziger Thomanerchor Bachs Messe in h-Moll aufführte. Angeblich ist es das größte Musikwerk, das die Welt je gesehen hat, wie der Komponist und Dirigent Carl Friedrich Zelter 1811 euphorisch schrieb. Die h-Moll-Messe ist das letzte große Chorwerk Johann Sebastian Bachs und fraglos auch der Höhepunkt in seinem Gesamtwerk. (Special, Music, Event) - 2015-09-24

classica.us.title: Bach - Sonate Nr. 5 BWV 1018
classica.us.description: Die Sonate Nr. 5 BWV 1014 ist die fünfte von Bachs Sonaten, die vor 1725 komponiert wurden. (Special, Music) - 2014-09-03

classica.us.title: Im Atelier des Künstlers
classica.us.description: In dieser Serie spielt der Pianist Philippe Cassard in einer Meisterklasse Werke von Claude Debussy. (Event, Music, Classical) - 2021-07-07

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 2, 'Auferstehung'
classica.us.description: Orchester und Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino unter der Leitung von Myung-Whun Chung spielen Mahlers Auferstehungssymphonie. Solistinnen sind Christiane Karg, Sopran, und Claudia Huckle, Alt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-16

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. (Documentary, Music) - 2019

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 5 in c-Moll, op. 67
classica.us.description: In der Oper von Dijon, wo das Ensemble residiert, interpretieren die Mitglieder von Les Dissonances die Symphonie Nr. 5 in C-Dur, Opus 67, von Ludwig van Beethoven. Die Originalität dieser Sinfonie liegt im anfänglichen Vier-Noten-Motiv. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2015-08-24
